source.sanskrit: GRETIL, Śivastotrāvalī (Bailly ed.), input S. Vasudeva
source.english: Swami Lakshmanjoo, Hymns to Shiva (Lakshmanjoo Academy)

chapters.label: Chapter One
chapters.title: The Ecstasy of Devotion

verses.iast: na dhyāyato na japataḥ syād yasyāvidhipūrvakam / evam eva śivabhāsas taṃ numo bhaktiśālinam
verses.devanagari: न ध्यायतो न जपतः स्याद् यस्याविधिपूर्वकम् / एवम् एव शिवभासस् तं नुमो भक्तिशालिनम्
verses.english: I bow to that devotee who is glorified with the devotion of Lord Śiva and to whom the appearance of Lord Śiva takes place without conducting meditation or recitation of any kind. He does not recite a mantra for Lord Śiva and he does not meditate, but even without meditation, without recitation, he attains the state where he feels the oneness of Lord Śiva. I bow to that devotee.

verses.iast: ātmā mama bhavadbhaktisudhāpānayuvāpi san / lokayātrārajorāgāt palitair iva dhūsaraḥ
verses.devanagari: आत्मा मम भवद्भक्तिसुधापानयुवापि सन् / लोकयात्रारजोरागात् पलितैर् इव धूसरः
verses.english: In fact, I am always young by adopting the, by tasting the, nectar of Thy devotion. I am always young. But still, in this worldly field, I feel that I am old enough, but internally I am young. Externally, I appear to be old because of too much exertion in these worldly activities, but I am always young because of tasting the nectar of Thy devotion.

verses.iast: labdhatatsaṃpadāṃ bhaktimatāṃ tvatpuravāsinām / saṃcāro lokamārge 'pi syāt tayaiva vijṛmbhayā
verses.devanagari: लब्धतत्संपदां भक्तिमतां त्वत्पुरवासिनाम् / संचारो लोकमार्गे ऽपि स्यात् तयैव विजृम्भया
verses.english: Although I am old because of being in contact with worldly people and worldly activities–I feel that I am old, I am exhausted–but internally, labdha tvat saṁpadām, those who have achieved the wealth of Your devotion5, and those who are truly devoted to You, and those who are residing in Thine kingdom, for them, activities in these worldly matters become one with that divinity of God consciousness.

verses.iast: sākṣādbhavanmaye nātha sarvasmin bhuvanāntare / kiṃ na bhaktimatāṃ kṣetram mantraḥ kvaiṣām na siddhyati
verses.devanagari: साक्षाद्भवन्मये नाथ सर्वस्मिन् भुवनान्तरे / किं न भक्तिमतां क्षेत्रम् मन्त्रः क्वैषाम् न सिद्ध्यति
verses.english: Nātha, O Lord, those people for whom this whole universe has become one with Your God consciousness and one with Your presence, for those people who feel Thy presence in each and every part and parcel of this worldly field, those are really Thy devotees.

verses.iast: jayanti bhaktipīyūṣarasāsavavaronmadāḥ / advitīyā api sadā tvaddvitīyā api prabho
verses.devanagari: जयन्ति भक्तिपीयूषरसासववरोन्मदाः / अद्वितीया अपि सदा त्वद्द्वितीया अपि प्रभो
verses.english: Prabho, O Master, bhaktipīyūṣa rasāsavavaronmadāḥ, those persons who have become mad by taking the ‘nectarized’ liquor of Thy devotion . . .

verses.iast: anantānandasindhos te nātha tattvaṃ vidanti te / tādṛśa eva ye sāndrabhaktyānandarasāplutāḥ
verses.devanagari: अनन्तानन्दसिन्धोस् ते नाथ तत्त्वं विदन्ति ते / तादृश एव ये सान्द्रभक्त्यानन्दरसाप्लुताः
verses.english: Nātha, O Master, only those people experience the reality of Thy ocean of God consciousness. Those people only experience the reality, experience the position or state, the real state of Thy God consciousness. Those people only, they experience. Who?

verses.iast: tvam evātmeśa sarvasya sarvaś cātmani rāgavān / iti svabhāvasiddhāṃs tvadbhaktiṃ jānañ jayej janaḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वम् एवात्मेश सर्वस्य सर्वश् चात्मनि रागवान् / इति स्वभावसिद्धांस् त्वद्भक्तिं जानञ् जयेज् जनः
verses.english: O Lord, You are the nature of everybody. In fact, You are the nature of everybody.

verses.iast: nātha vedyakṣaye kena na dṛśyo 'syekakaḥ sthitaḥ / vedyavedakasaṃkṣobhe 'py asi bhaktaiḥ sudarśanaḥ
verses.devanagari: नाथ वेद्यक्षये केन न दृश्यो ऽस्येककः स्थितः / वेद्यवेदकसंक्षोभे ऽप्य् असि भक्तैः सुदर्शनः
verses.english: O my Master, it is a fact that You are achieved when [one] shuns all worldly activities. After shunning each and every worldly activity, You are achieved. This is a fact. You are not achieved till then, unless you shun all of these outward, worldly matters. But, when by shunning these outward worldly matters You are achieved, what greatness is there in achieving [You in] this way? There is no greatness in achieving this way, achieving You this way.

verses.iast: anantānandasarasī devī priyatamā yathā / aviyuktāsti te tadvad ekā tvadbhaktir astu me
verses.devanagari: अनन्तानन्दसरसी देवी प्रियतमा यथा / अवियुक्तास्ति ते तद्वद् एका त्वद्भक्तिर् अस्तु मे
verses.english: Now, there is one problem for me.

verses.iast: sarva eva bhavallābhahetur bhaktimatāṃ vibho / saṃvinmārgo 'yam āhlādaduḥkhamohais tridhā sthitaḥ
verses.devanagari: सर्व एव भवल्लाभहेतुर् भक्तिमतां विभो / संविन्मार्गो ऽयम् आह्लाददुःखमोहैस् त्रिधा स्थितः
verses.english: This universal path, which is filled in a three-fold way . . .

verses.iast: bhavadbhaktyamṛtāsvādād bodhasya syāt parāpi yā / daśā sā māṃ prati svāmin nāsavasyeva śuktatā
verses.devanagari: भवद्भक्त्यमृतास्वादाद् बोधस्य स्यात् परापि या / दशा सा मां प्रति स्वामिन् नासवस्येव शुक्तता
verses.english: Have you ever tasted this liquor? Have you ever tasted liquor?

verses.iast: bhavadbhaktimahāvidyā yeṣām abhyāsam āgatā / vidyāvidyobhayasyāpi tā ete tattvavedinaḥ
verses.devanagari: भवद्भक्तिमहाविद्या येषाम् अभ्यासम् आगता / विद्याविद्योभयस्यापि ता एते तत्त्ववेदिनः
verses.english: Those people who have experienced the supreme knowledge of Thy devotion–who have already experienced the supreme knowledge of Your devotion–those are only experienced in discriminating what is knowledge and what is the absence of knowledge. Knowledge and the absence of knowledge, only they can discriminate, not anybody else.

verses.iast: āmulād vāglatā seyaṃ kramavisphāraśālinī / tvadbhaktisudhayā siktā tadrasāḍhyaphalāstu me
verses.devanagari: आमुलाद् वाग्लता सेयं क्रमविस्फारशालिनी / त्वद्भक्तिसुधया सिक्ता तद्रसाढ्यफलास्तु मे
verses.english: This expansion of the universal state of life is really a creeper, is just like a creeper, a grown creeper (latā). Āmūlāt vāk latā seyaṁ kramam, and this vāk latā, this vine of sound (parā, paśyantī, madhyamā, and vaikharī) . . .

verses.iast: śivo bhūtvā yajeteti bhakto bhūtveti kathyate / tvam eva hi vapuḥ sāraṃ bhaktair advayaśodhitam
verses.devanagari: शिवो भूत्वा यजेतेति भक्तो भूत्वेति कथ्यते / त्वम् एव हि वपुः सारं भक्तैर् अद्वयशोधितम्
verses.english: In the Vedās, in the Śiva Sūtras, in all of those sacred books, this is said that, “you must worship Lord Śiva after becoming Lord Śiva Himself”.

verses.iast: bhaktānāṃ bhavadadvaitasiddhyai kā nopapattayaḥ / tadasiddhyai nikṛṣṭānāṃ kāni nāvaraṇāni vā
verses.devanagari: भक्तानां भवदद्वैतसिद्ध्यै का नोपपत्तयः / तदसिद्ध्यै निकृष्टानां कानि नावरणानि वा
verses.english: Those who are Thy devotees, for those, if they want to achieve the state of God consciousness, for them, which is not the way? Even going astray also will lead them to God consciousness.

verses.iast: kadācit kvāpi labhyo 'si yogenetīśa vañcanā / anyathā sarvakakṣyāsu bhāsi bhaktimatāṃ katham
verses.devanagari: कदाचित् क्वापि लभ्यो ऽसि योगेनेतीश वञ्चना / अन्यथा सर्वकक्ष्यासु भासि भक्तिमतां कथम्
verses.english: O Lord, when You are achieved by some particular yoga exercise or by a particular meditation, and You are achieved when a person, a devotee, is sentenced to a cave or some secluded corner [and remains] without the struggle of universal activities, then you are achieved by some particular adoption of a particular yoga, but this is a deceit. In a real sense, this is deceit.9

verses.iast: pratyāhārādyasaṃspṛṣṭo viśeṣo 'sti mahānayam / yogibhyo bhaktibhājām yad vyutthāne 'pi samāhitāḥ
verses.devanagari: प्रत्याहाराद्यसंस्पृष्टो विशेषो ऽस्ति महानयम् / योगिभ्यो भक्तिभाजाम् यद् व्युत्थाने ऽपि समाहिताः
verses.english: There is a great difference between yogīs and Your devotees. Yogīs do find You and do realize Your nature by maintaining pratyāhāra11, and meditation, and so on. Otherwise, they can’t realize Your nature.

verses.iast: na yogo na tapo nārcākramaḥ ko 'pi pranīyate / amāye śivamārge 'smin bhaktir ekā praśasyate
verses.devanagari: न योगो न तपो नार्चाक्रमः को ऽपि प्रनीयते / अमाये शिवमार्गे ऽस्मिन् भक्तिर् एका प्रशस्यते
verses.english: On this path of Śiva mārga, on this path of Lord Śiva, which is without . . . which is away from all delusion, amāye, which is absolutely pure and straight, on this path of Lord Śiva, no yoga is needed, no penance is needed, and no worship, no mode of worship, is needed. The need here is only of devotion, pure devotion. If they are really attached to You, they will find You. If they are not attached [to You], they may perform yoga, they may perform penance, and they may perform pūjā, but they cannot find You. Bhakti12 is the only means to find Your nature.

verses.iast: sarvato vilasadbhaktitejodhvastāvṛter mama / pratyakṣasarvabhāvasya cintānām api naśyatu
verses.devanagari: सर्वतो विलसद्भक्तितेजोध्वस्तावृतेर् मम / प्रत्यक्षसर्वभावस्य चिन्तानाम् अपि नश्यतु
verses.english: O Lord, I am, in the real sense . . . I have, in the real sense, perceived the real nature of the universe. Pratyakṣa sarva bhāvasya, all the universal objective field I have perceived [clearly] because all ignorance has been shunned; all ignorance has been carried away by the light of Your devotion.

verses.iast: śiva ity ekaśabdasya jihvāgre tiṣṭhataḥ sadā / samastaviṣayāsvādo bhakteṣv evāsti ko 'py aho
verses.devanagari: शिव इत्य् एकशब्दस्य जिह्वाग्रे तिष्ठतः सदा / समस्तविषयास्वादो भक्तेष्व् एवास्ति को ऽप्य् अहो
verses.english: This is a great wonder (aho, this is a great wonder) that when you recite only the name, this sound “Śiva”, and this sound of “Śiva” resides on the tip of your tongue, jihvāgre vasataḥ sadā, in continuity, samasta viṣayāsvādo bhakteṣvevāsti, you don’t realize the nectar of His name only, you realize the nectar of His touch, you realize the nectar of His embrace, you realize the nectar of His smell, you realize everything of Lord Śiva there.

verses.iast: śāntakallolaśītācchasvādubhaktisudhāmbudhau / alaukikarasāsvāde susthaiḥ ko 'nāma gaṇyate
verses.devanagari: शान्तकल्लोलशीताच्छस्वादुभक्तिसुधाम्बुधौ / अलौकिकरसास्वादे सुस्थैः को ऽनाम गण्यते
verses.english: Those who are bent upon tasting that unique nectar, when they dive in the ocean of the nectar of Thy devotion, which is sweet, which is fresh, which is śīta . . .

verses.iast: sādṛśaiḥ kiṃ na carvyeta bhavadbhaktimahauṣadhiḥ / tādṛśī bhagavan yasyā mokṣākhyo 'nantaro rasaḥ
verses.devanagari: सादृशैः किं न चर्व्येत भवद्भक्तिमहौषधिः / तादृशी भगवन् यस्या मोक्षाख्यो ऽनन्तरो रसः
verses.english: Bhagavan, O Lord, those who are just like me, mādṛśaiḥ, why should they not taste the nectar of the herb of Your devotion? And by which taste they don’t achieve the taste of that devotion only, they achieve the taste of liberation also. They are jīvan muktas13 at the same time.

verses.iast: tā eva paramarthyante sampadaḥ sadbhir īśa yāḥ / tvad bhaktirasasambhogavisrambhaparipoṣikāḥ
verses.devanagari: ता एव परमर्थ्यन्ते सम्पदः सद्भिर् ईश याः / त्वद् भक्तिरससम्भोगविस्रम्भपरिपोषिकाः
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, that wealth is only longed for and desired by those saints–that wealth is longed for and desired by those saints–[which is] the wealth that produces and strengthens the fire of desire for embracing that bhakti rasa, in embracing Thy nectar of bhakti, Thy nectar of devotion.15

verses.iast: bhavadbhaktisudhāsāras taiḥ kim apy upalakṣitaḥ / ye na rāgādi paṅke 'smiṃḷ lipyante patitā api
verses.devanagari: भवद्भक्तिसुधासारस् तैः किम् अप्य् उपलक्षितः / ये न रागादि पङ्के ऽस्मिंऌ लिप्यन्ते पतिता अपि
verses.english: Those [saints], although living and remaining in the field of rāga16, greed, anger, lust, i.e., in the muddy sphere of rāga, etc. . . .

verses.iast: aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣv aṅgeṣv eva phalābhidhā / bhavadbhakter vipakvāyā latāyā iva keṣu cit
verses.devanagari: अणिमादिषु मोक्षान्तेष्व् अङ्गेष्व् एव फलाभिधा / भवद्भक्तेर् विपक्वाया लताया इव केषु चित्
verses.english: In this universe, there is only one shining creeper (a grown shining creeper), that is the creeper of Your devotion. When that creeper of Your devotion is in its full bloom, when it has bloomed perfectly, then you find in this very creeper all kinds of fruits. It bears all kinds of fruits for you, not only . . . for instance, right from the great yogic powers up to the great power of being liberated from repeated births and deaths (that is mokṣa), aṇimādiṣu mokṣānteṣu, all of these powers come into existence in that creeper of Your devotion. It means that the creeper of Thy devotion bears not only [the fruit of] Thy devotion, but it also bears [the fruit of] all yogic powers including final liberation (mokṣa). But, in predominance, it bears devotion; devotion is in predominance. The fruit of devotion it bears in predominance and [yogīc powers and mokṣa are] apradhāna.

verses.iast: citraṃ nisargato nātha duḥkhabījam idaṃ manaḥ / tvadbhaktirasasaṃsiktam niḥśreyasamahāphalam
verses.devanagari: चित्रं निसर्गतो नाथ दुःखबीजम् इदं मनः / त्वद्भक्तिरससंसिक्तम् निःश्रेयसमहाफलम्
verses.english: Nātha, O desired Lord, this is also a great wonder to me that, in reality, by nature, this mind is the seed of pain, sorrow, sadness, torture. This mind is the seed of torture, sorrow, sadness–all bad things. All bad things are [produced] by this seed.

chapters.label: Chapter Two
chapters.title: Everything is Found in Everything

verses.iast: agnīṣomaravibrahmaviṣṇusthāvarajaṅgama / svarūpa bahurūpāya namaḥ saṃvinmayāya te
verses.devanagari: अग्नीषोमरविब्रह्मविष्णुस्थावरजङ्गम / स्वरूप बहुरूपाय नमः संविन्मयाय ते
verses.english: O Lord, You are fire, You are the moon, You are the sun.

verses.iast: viśvendhanamahākṣārānulepaśucivarcase / mahānalāya bhavate viśvaikahaviṣe namaḥ
verses.devanagari: विश्वेन्धनमहाक्षारानुलेपशुचिवर्चसे / महानलाय भवते विश्वैकहविषे नमः
verses.english: O Lord, I bow to that supreme fire of Thee, of Thy consciousness, which is śucivarcase, which is absolutely glorified by pure prakāśa (pure light) by absorbing this universe into nothingness, by burning this universe into no substance, because this is the great fire.

verses.iast: paramāmṛtasāndrāya śītalāya śivāgnaye / kasmai cid viśvasaṃploṣaviṣamāya namo 'stu te
verses.devanagari: परमामृतसान्द्राय शीतलाय शिवाग्नये / कस्मै चिद् विश्वसंप्लोषविषमाय नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.english: I bow to that supreme fire of God Consciousness, supreme fire of Lord Śiva (śivāgnaye namaḥ), which is paramāmṛta sāndrāya, which fire is cooled down by supreme nectar.

verses.iast: mahādevāya rudrāya śaṅkarāya śivāya te / maheśvarāyāpi namaḥ kasmai cin mantramūrtaye
verses.devanagari: महादेवाय रुद्राय शङ्कराय शिवाय ते / महेश्वरायापि नमः कस्मै चिन् मन्त्रमूर्तये
verses.english: I bow to Mahādeva, I bow to Rūdra, I bow to Śaṅkara, I bow to Śiva, I bow to Maheśvara, I bow to that unique being of God consciousness of Śiva.

verses.iast: namo nikṛttaniḥśoṣatrailokyavigaladvasā- / vasekaviṣamāyāpi maṅgalāya śivāgnaye
verses.devanagari: नमो निकृत्तनिःशोषत्रैलोक्यविगलद्वसा- / वसेकविषमायापि मङ्गलाय शिवाग्नये
verses.english: I bow to that Śiva agni, the fire of Śiva, who is viṣama (viṣama is “furious, frightening”).

verses.iast: samastalakṣanāyoga eva yasyopalakṣaṇam / tasmai namo 'stu devāya kasmai cid api śambhave
verses.devanagari: समस्तलक्षनायोग एव यस्योपलक्षणम् / तस्मै नमो ऽस्तु देवाय कस्मै चिद् अपि शम्भवे
verses.english: I bow to that unique being of Lord Śiva, whose sign of perception is perceiving Him in no way.

verses.iast: vedāgamaviruddhāya vedāgamavidhāyine / vedāgamasatattvāya guhyāya svāmine namaḥ
verses.devanagari: वेदागमविरुद्धाय वेदागमविधायिने / वेदागमसतत्त्वाय गुह्याय स्वामिने नमः
verses.english: I bow to my Master who is absolutely against the theory of the Vedās and Tantras. I bow to that Master who is against the theory of the Vedās and Tantras and I bow to Him who is in favor of the Vedās and Tantras. I bow to Him who is actually the essence of the Vedās and Tantras. I bow to Him who is always hidden, who is always the secret to everything.

verses.iast: saṃsāraikanimittāya saṃsāraikavirodhine / namaḥ samsārarūpāya niḥsaṃsārāya śambhave
verses.devanagari: संसारैकनिमित्ताय संसारैकविरोधिने / नमः सम्साररूपाय निःसंसाराय शम्भवे
verses.english: He is the only cause of producing this wheel of repeated births and deaths (saṁsāra), producing the wheel of this torture of the universe. He is the only cause.

verses.iast: mūlāya madhyāyāgrāya mūlamadhyāgramūrtaye / kṣīnāgramadhyamūlāya namaḥ pūrṇāya śambhave
verses.devanagari: मूलाय मध्यायाग्राय मूलमध्याग्रमूर्तये / क्षीनाग्रमध्यमूलाय नमः पूर्णाय शम्भवे
verses.english: I bow to that Lord Śiva who is all-round complete (pūrṇāya śāmbhave). Who is found at the root, I bow to that Lord Śiva who is found at the root of everything. Who is found at madhyāya, who is found at the center of everything, I bow to that Lord Śiva who is found at the center of everything. I bow to that Lord Śiva who is found at the top of everything.

verses.iast: namaḥ sukṛtasaṃbharavipākaḥ sakṛd apy asau / yasya nāmagrahas tasmai durlabhāya śivāya te
verses.devanagari: नमः सुकृतसंभरविपाकः सकृद् अप्य् असौ / यस्य नामग्रहस् तस्मै दुर्लभाय शिवाय ते
verses.english: I bow to that Lord Śiva who sukṛta saṁbhāra vipākaḥ sakṛt apyasau yasya nāmagrahaḥ, when you recite His name only once, once in your life, if you recite His name just once in your life, sukṛta saṁbhāra vipākaḥ, it means all your . . .

verses.iast: namaścarācarākāraparetanicayaiḥ sadā / krīḍate tubhyam ekasmai cinmayāya kapāline
verses.devanagari: नमश्चराचराकारपरेतनिचयैः सदा / क्रीडते तुभ्यम् एकस्मै चिन्मयाय कपालिने
verses.english: I bow to that Lord Śiva who is the only one cinmaya, one conscious Being, found in all of the unconscious world, i.e., [in those] who are pareta [ghosts]; some are moving, some are not moving.

verses.iast: māyāvine viśuddhāya guhyāya prakaṭātmane / sūkṣmāya viśvarūpāya namaś citrāya śambhave
verses.devanagari: मायाविने विशुद्धाय गुह्याय प्रकटात्मने / सूक्ष्माय विश्वरूपाय नमश् चित्राय शम्भवे
verses.english: I bow to that wonderful being of Lord Śiva who is deceitful, always deceitful, who deceives each and every being, and who is pure, straightforward; at the same time, who is straightforward.

verses.iast: brahmendraviṣṇunirvyūḍhajagatsaṃhārakelaye / āścaryakaraṇīyāya namas te sarvaśaktaye
verses.devanagari: ब्रह्मेन्द्रविष्णुनिर्व्यूढजगत्संहारकेलये / आश्चर्यकरणीयाय नमस् ते सर्वशक्तये
verses.english: I bow to Thee, O Lord Śiva, who is all-powerful (sarva śaktaye). I bow to Thee who is always possessing all powers and who does act wonderfully (āścaryakaraṇīyāya).

verses.iast: taṭeṣv eva paribhrāntaiḥ labdhās tās tā vibhūtayaḥ / yasya tasmai namas tubhyam agādhaharasindhave
verses.devanagari: तटेष्व् एव परिभ्रान्तैः लब्धास् तास् ता विभूतयः / यस्य तस्मै नमस् तुभ्यम् अगाधहरसिन्धवे
verses.english: I bow to Thee who is just like agādha (agādha means “unlimited ocean of God consciousness”), the unlimited ocean of Thy being. I bow to That unlimited ocean on whose shores . . .

verses.iast: māyāmayajagatsāndrapaṅkamadhyādhivāsine / alepāya namaḥ śambhuśatapatrāya śobhine
verses.devanagari: मायामयजगत्सान्द्रपङ्कमध्याधिवासिने / अलेपाय नमः शम्भुशतपत्राय शोभिने
verses.english: Śobhine śambhu śatapatrāya namaḥ. I bow to that beautiful lotus, lotus-like Lord Śiva.

verses.iast: maṅgalāya pavitrāya nidhaye bhūṣaṇātmane / priyāya paramārthāya sarvotkṛṣṭāya te namaḥ
verses.devanagari: मङ्गलाय पवित्राय निधये भूषणात्मने / प्रियाय परमार्थाय सर्वोत्कृष्टाय ते नमः
verses.english: O Lord, I bow to Thee, who is always maṅgala, maṅgala svarūpa, and who is pavitrāya, who is all-round pure.

verses.iast: namaḥ satatabaddhāya nityanirmuktibhāgine / bandhamokṣavihīnāya kasmai ci d api śambhave
verses.devanagari: नमः सततबद्धाय नित्यनिर्मुक्तिभागिने / बन्धमोक्षविहीनाय कस्मै चि द् अपि शम्भवे
verses.english: I bow to that unique Lord Śiva who is always bound in the objective world, nitya nirmukti bhāgine, and who is always absolutely liberated from these bondages. Bandha mokṣa vihīnāya, and, in fact, who is without bondages and without liberation. Kasmaicit, it is why He is supreme, unique (apūrva).

verses.iast: upahāsaikasāre 'sminn etāvati jagattraye / tubhyam evādvitīyāya namo nityasukhāsine
verses.devanagari: उपहासैकसारे ऽस्मिन्न् एतावति जगत्त्रये / तुभ्यम् एवाद्वितीयाय नमो नित्यसुखासिने
verses.english: I bow to Thee only, O Lord, who is in this universe, which is the essence of upahāsa, which has become the root of upahāsa, root of nothingness, where there is only upahāsa.

verses.iast: dakṣiṇācārasārāya vāmācārābhilāṣiṇe / sarvācārāya śarvāya nirācārāya te namaḥ
verses.devanagari: दक्षिणाचारसाराय वामाचाराभिलाषिणे / सर्वाचाराय शर्वाय निराचाराय ते नमः
verses.english: O Lord, I bow to Thee who is the essence of dakṣiṇācāra.

verses.iast: yathā tathāpi yaḥ pūjyo yatra tatrāpi yo 'rcitaḥ / yo 'pi vā so 'pi vā yo 'sau devas tasmai namo 'stu te
verses.devanagari: यथा तथापि यः पूज्यो यत्र तत्रापि यो ऽर्चितः / यो ऽपि वा सो ऽपि वा यो ऽसौ देवस् तस्मै नमो ऽस्तु ते
verses.english: I bow to Thee, O Lord, who is adored in each and every way of worship, yatra tatrāpi yo’rcitaḥ, and who is worshiped in each and every place.

verses.iast: mumukṣujanasevyāya sarvasantāpahāriṇe / namo vitatalāvaṇyavarāya varadāya te
verses.devanagari: मुमुक्षुजनसेव्याय सर्वसन्तापहारिणे / नमो विततलावण्यवराय वरदाय ते
verses.english: I bow to Thee who is the bestower of boons (varadāya), who bestows boons to Your devotees, to Thy devotees, and who is vitata lāvaṇya vārāya, who is the embodiment of infinite beauty, . . .

verses.iast: sadā nirantarānandarasanirbharitākhila- / trilokāya namas tubhyaṃ svāmine nityaparvaṇe
verses.devanagari: सदा निरन्तरानन्दरसनिर्भरिताखिल- / त्रिलोकाय नमस् तुभ्यं स्वामिने नित्यपर्वणे
verses.english: I bow to my Master, I bow to Thee who is my Master, and who always possesses festivals, where You have got festivals every day, every second, every moment. Festivals are [always] being functioned in Your kingdom.

verses.iast: sukhapradhānasaṃvedyasambhogair bhajate ca yat / tvām eva tasmai ghorāya śaktivṛndāya te namaḥ
verses.devanagari: सुखप्रधानसंवेद्यसम्भोगैर् भजते च यत् / त्वाम् एव तस्मै घोराय शक्तिवृन्दाय ते नमः
verses.english: O Lord, I don’t bow to Thee; I bow to Thy class of energies. I bow to Thy class of energies, Thy innumerable energies who adore Thee only (tvāmeva bhajate, who adore Thee only) by beautiful śabda, sparśa, rūpa, rasa, and gandha.44

verses.iast: munīnām apy avijñeyaṃ bhaktisambandhaceṣṭitāḥ / āliṅganty api yaṃ tasmai kasmai cid bhavate namaḥ
verses.devanagari: मुनीनाम् अप्य् अविज्ञेयं भक्तिसम्बन्धचेष्टिताः / आलिङ्गन्त्य् अपि यं तस्मै कस्मै चिद् भवते नमः
verses.english: Those who are ṛṣis and munis, who have discarded all of the pleasures of the universe, all worldly pleasures–who have kept away all worldly pleasures and directed their consciousness towards the recitation and meditation of Lord Śiva, those are called munis, ṛṣis–those ṛṣis also do not find Thee, O Lord. You are absolutely away from their perception. You are not perceived by them.

verses.iast: paramāmṛtakośāya paramāmṛtarāśaye / sarvapāramyapāramyaprāpyāya bhavate namaḥ
verses.devanagari: परमामृतकोशाय परमामृतराशये / सर्वपारम्यपारम्यप्राप्याय भवते नमः
verses.english: I bow to Thee, O Lord, who is the treasure of the supreme nectar of God consciousness and who is paramāmṛta rāśaye, who is the rāśi, who is the mass of supreme nectar, who is the treasure of supreme nectar (paramāmṛta kośāya).

verses.iast: mahāmantramayaṃ naumi rūpaṃ te svacchaśītalam / apūrvamodasubhagaṃ parāmṛtarasolvaṇam
verses.devanagari: महामन्त्रमयं नौमि रूपं ते स्वच्छशीतलम् / अपूर्वमोदसुभगं परामृतरसोल्वणम्
verses.english: I bow to Thy form (te rūpaṁ naumi) who is mahāmantra mayaṁ, filled with the supreme mantra, filled with supreme I-consciousness, universal I-consciousness–who is only universal I-consciousness, I bow to Thee–and whose form is svacchaśītalam, whose form is always transparent, always cooling (śītalam, ṭhaṇḍa53).

verses.iast: svātantryāmṛtapūrṇatvad aikyakhyātimahāpaṭe / citraṃ nāsty eva yatreśa tan naumi tava śāsanam
verses.devanagari: स्वातन्त्र्यामृतपूर्णत्वद् ऐक्यख्यातिमहापटे / चित्रं नास्त्य् एव यत्रेश तन् नौमि तव शासनम्
verses.english: O Lord, I bow to Thy śāsanam, to Thy śāstra, to Thy spiritual order, in which order form, nothing is written (citraṁ nāstyeva, nothing is written). It is only just a [blank] sheet only, a clear order form from Lord Śiva. And it is written, this order is written, on svātantrya amṛtapūrṇa tvadaikyakhyāti, which is the perception of Your Being, Your transcendental state, which is filled with the nectar of independence.55 Your svarūpa is filled with the nectar of independence, and that nectar of independence is the sheet on which You have written orders, and on that sheet, nothing is written. I bow to that sheet, that order sheet, of Yours.

verses.iast: sarvāśaṅkāsaniṃ sarvālakṣmīkālānalaṃ tathā / sarvāmaṅgalyakalpāntaṃ mārgaṃ māheśvaraṃ numaḥ
verses.devanagari: सर्वाशङ्कासनिं सर्वालक्ष्मीकालानलं तथा / सर्वामङ्गल्यकल्पान्तं मार्गं माहेश्वरं नुमः
verses.english: I bow to the path of Lord Śiva, the path of Lord Śiva . . .

verses.iast: jaya deva namo namo 'stu te sakalaṃ viśvam idaṃ tavāśritam / jagatāṃ parameśvaro bhavān paramekaḥ śaraṇāgato 'smi te
verses.devanagari: जय देव नमो नमो ऽस्तु ते सकलं विश्वम् इदं तवाश्रितम् / जगतां परमेश्वरो भवान् परमेकः शरणागतो ऽस्मि ते
verses.english: O Lord, be victorious! Jayadeva! O Lord, be victorious! Namo namo’stu te, I bow to Thee again and again. Sakalaṁ viśvaṁidaṁ tavāśritam, all this world is dependent on You. Jagatāṁ parameśvaraḥ bhavān, You are the Master of all the three worlds. I am the only person who has come and taken Your refuge.

chapters.label: Chapter Three
chapters.title: Pleasing the Lord in Humble Ways

verses.iast: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ / tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave
verses.devanagari: सदसत्त्वेन भावानां युक्ता या द्वितयी गतिः / ताम् उल्लङ्घ्य तृतीयस्मै नमश् चित्राय शम्भवे
verses.english: I bow to that wonderful Lord Śiva.

verses.iast: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye / svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ
verses.devanagari: आसुरर्षिजनाद् अस्मिन्न् अस्वतन्त्रे जगत्त्रये / स्वतन्त्रास् ते स्वतन्त्रस्य ये तवैवानुजीविनः
verses.english: In fact, in this triple universe, three-fold universe, everyone is dependent, everyone is asvātantrya, without svātantrya, without independence. It is dependent! The whole body of the three worlds is dependent to this thing or that thing.

verses.iast: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ / yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ
verses.devanagari: अशेषविश्वखचितभवद्वपुर् अनुस्मृतिः / येषाम् भवरुजाम् एकं भेषजं ते सुखासिनः
verses.english: Those who possess only one dose [of medicine] for getting rid of the universe of difference, bhava roga . . .

verses.iast: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ / cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ
verses.devanagari: सितातपत्रं यस्येन्दुः स्वप्रभापरिपूरितः / चामरं स्वर्धुनीस्रोतः स एकः परमेश्वरः
verses.english: He only is Lord Śiva, He only is the real master of the universe (sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ, He only is the master of the universe) who has used the moon as an umbrella, who has used the moon as an umbrella for Him[self]. Sitātapatraṁ yasyendu, the moon is, for Him, [used] as an umbrella. [He] who has got the moon in the place of an umbrella and cāmaraṁ svardhunīsrotaḥ, and this Milky Way is an electric fan (cāmaraṁ64). The Milky Way is an electric fan for that Being. For whom the Milky Way serves as an electric fan (cāmara) and this moon serves in place of an umbrella, sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ, He is the only master existing in this universe.

verses.iast: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva / dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm
verses.devanagari: प्रकाशां शीतलाम् एकां शुद्धां शशिकलाम् इव / दृशं वितर मे नाथ काम् अप्य् अमृतवाहिनीम्
verses.english: O desired Lord (Nātha, O desired Lord), throw Your kind glance on me (dṛśaṁ vitara me, throw Your kind glance on me), and that glance which is prakāśām, filled with light, śītalām, which is filled with coolness–and with only one glance; I want only one glance of Thee–and which is always all-round purified (śuddhām) just like śaśikalām, just like the ray of the moon, the kalā of the [moon]. Throw that glance on me, O Lord, which is kāmapi, which is a unique glance, and amṛtavāhinī, which flows, which will flow out, floods of nectar on me.

verses.iast: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ / imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वच्चिदानन्दजलधेश् च्युताः संवित्तिविप्रुषः / इमाः कथं मे भगवन् नामृतास्वादसुन्दराः
verses.english: Here, the commentary of Kṣemarāja is not being digested by me, i.e., the commentary of Kṣemarāja for this śloka.68

verses.iast: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho / yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वयि रागरसे नाथ न मग्नं हृदयं प्रभो / येषाम् अहृदया एव ते ऽवज्ञस्पदम् ईदृशाः
verses.english: O my Master, those whose mind has not dived into the nectar of Thy devotion, ahṛdaya eva te, they have no mind. From my point of view, they have no mind. Those persons are mindless, absolutely mindless. Avajñāspadamīdṛśāḥ, such people are absolutely avajñāspadam, to be thrown away, just like ordinary stones.

verses.iast: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam / prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam
verses.devanagari: प्रभुणा भवता यस्य जातं हृदयमेलनम् / प्राभवीणां विभूतीनां परमेकः स भाजनम्
verses.english: [One] who has achieved the oneness of heart with Thee, O Master, O my Master, he who has achieved the oneness of heart with Thee, he is the only person who is worthy of enjoying the nectar of Thy state, Thy state of God consciousness. The nectar of Thy glorious state is tasted by him only.

verses.iast: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam / bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva
verses.devanagari: हर्षाणाम् अथ शोकानां सर्वेषां प्लावकः समम् / भवद्ध्यानामृतापूरो निम्नाणिम्नभुवाम् इव
verses.english: O Lord, bhavat dhyāna amṛtāpūraḥ, the great flood of the nectar of Thy meditation–meditating upon You is the flood of nectar that flows out (bhavat dhyāna amṛtāpūra)–the large flood of the nectar of Thy meditation is harṣāṇāmatha śokānāṁ sarveṣaṁ plāvakaḥ samam, it floods, in the same level, all joys and all sorrows, just like nimnānimna bhuvāmiva, just like low and high grounds are flooded in the same river by a great flood. The flood levels [cover] the ups and downs of the grounds so it is in one level.

verses.iast: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā / yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā
verses.devanagari: केव न स्याद् दृशा तेषां सुखसम्भारनिर्भरा / येषाम् आत्माधिकेनेश न क्वापि विरहस् त्वया
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, for those persons, those who are exceptions [amongst] these human beings, those who are an exception, to whom ātmādhikena tayā na kvāpi virahaḥ, You are, for them, You are more than their [own] lives, more than their own existence, more than their own existence in this universe–You are more than that for them–for those persons, all states of their lives are filled with the excess of joy, every now and then74. Teṣāṁ sukha sambhāradaśā kā eva na syāt, constantly, by the excess of joy, filled with the excess of joy, all states, for them, all states of their livelihood are filled with the excess of joy, always. They are filled with joy. They never become sad. For whom You are more than their lives, and they are not separated, they don’t remain away from You for even one second–na kvāpī virahastvayā, they don’t remain away from You, away from Your consciousness–for those [people], all states of their lives are filled with the excess of joy, always.

verses.iast: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ / svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ
verses.devanagari: गर्जामि बत नृत्यामि पूर्णा मम मनोरथाः / स्वामी ममैष घटितो यत् त्वम् अत्यन्तरोचनः
verses.english: As You are my atyanta rocanaḥ, You are always dearest to me (atyanta rocanaḥ)–I love You, I long for Your presence (atyanta rocanaḥ)–as You who are so loved by me, [You are thereby] devised or solved for me. You are devised or solved for me. So, You have come and You are present with me. You are always with me now because You are ghaṭita, attained, solved. The problem is solved. This was my problem, i.e., to attain You, and that I have achieved. This was the only problem in my life to attain You, to attain Your presence, and That presence is solved for me. Hence, garjāmi, I will emit a deep thundering sound now with joy (garjāmi) and bata nṛtyāmi (nṛtyāmi means “I will dance”).

verses.iast: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat / jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate
verses.devanagari: नान्यद् वेद्यं क्रिया यत्र नान्यो योगो विदा च यत् / ज्ञानं स्यात् किं तु विश्वैकपूर्णा चित्त्वं विजृम्भते
verses.english: Where there is no other object of perception, where there is no other action, where there is no other yoga, practice of yoga, and where there is no other way of thinking, and where there is no other knowledge than Thee, than the knowledge of Thy own nature, there only the kingdom of consciousness is glorified, shines from all sides, in which consciousness this whole differentiated world becomes one offering in That fire of consciousness.

verses.iast: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te / hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ
verses.devanagari: दुर्जयानाम् अनन्तानाम् दुःखानां सहसैव ते / हस्तात् पलायिता येषां वाचि शश्वच्छिवध्वनिः
verses.english: Those persons in whose mouth this sound of “Śiva” is residing eternally, without any break–those who recite this mantra of “Śiva” without any break, in continuity–those persons have escaped from the grip of unlimited and uncontrollable duḥkha’s (the tortures of the universe). The tortures of the universe, which are numberless and which are uncontrollable, which you can’t conquer, they can’t be conquered, and they have escaped from the grip of those tortures in an instant, all of a sudden, i.e., in whose mouth this Śiva dhvani77 is continuously flowing.

verses.iast: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ / tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ
verses.devanagari: उत्तमः पुरुषो ऽन्यो ऽस्ति युष्मच्छेषविशेषितः / त्वं महापुरुषस् त्व् एको निःशेषपुरुषाश्रयः
verses.english: Actually, in this world of action, there are three persons existing, grammatically. One is first person, the other is second person, and the other is third person. First person, second person, and . . . first person indicates “I”, second person indicates “you”, third person indicates “he”. Uttamaḥ puruṣo, but it is already admitted in this world of actions that whenever you three–for instance, you, this woman, and this woman–do some work jointly and you have to . . . when you [want to say] to me that “we are working jointly”, you don’t say “I am working jointly, she is working jointly, and she is working jointly”. What do you say there? “We are working!” So, the first person is predominant in all these three persons from the grammatical point of view. First person is the chief. So, we attribute first person for all of these three persons, i.e., for him, for you, and for myself. We say, “we are reading”. Uttamaḥ puruṣa. In the same way, uttamaḥ puruṣa, this first person is anya, [more] supreme than yuṣmat śeṣaviśeṣitaḥ, than the second person and the third person.

verses.iast: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho / saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ
verses.devanagari: जयन्ति ते जगद्वन्द्या दासास् ते जगतां विभो / संसारार्णव एवैष येषां क्रीडामहासरः
verses.english: Jagatāṁ vibho, O Lord of the three worlds (he calls Him “the Lord of the three worlds”), they are victorious, those persons are victorious, who are Thy slaves, who art Thy slaves, who are Your slaves. And they are actually Your slaves, but, on the contrary, they are respected by the whole universe. Although they are Your slaves, they are honored and respected by all of the three worlds. Everybody respects them because they are Your slaves. The slaves of the Lord are respected by everybody.

verses.iast: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām / tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate
verses.devanagari: आसतां तावद् अन्यानि दैन्यानीह भवज्जुषाम् / त्वम् एव प्रकटीभूया इत्य् अनेनैव लज्ज्यते
verses.english: Those who are Thy devotees, who are Your devotees, who have taken refuge in Your Being, let other miserable states or griefs remain unsolved for them (tāvad anyāni dainyānīha, other miserable states or griefs in this world).

verses.iast: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ / tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit
verses.devanagari: मत्परं नास्ति तत्रापि जापको ऽस्मि तदैक्यतः / तत्त्वेन जप इत्य् अक्षमालया दिशसि क्वचित्
verses.english: O Lord, there is one painting of Your form available in the market.

verses.iast: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho / tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ
verses.devanagari: सतो ऽवश्यं परमसत् सच् च तस्मात् परं प्रभो / त्वं चासतः सतश् चान्यस् तेनासि सदसन्मयः
verses.english: Prabho, O Master, sato’vaśyaṁ paramasat, it is a fact that an existing thing is absolutely other than a non-existent object; that existent object is other than a non-existent object. Sat (existence) is other than asat (non-existence), sato avaśyaṁ paraṁ asat, sat ca tasmāt paraṁ prabho, and that existent object is other than a non-existent object. Tvaṁ cāsatassataścānya, but You are something else. You are neither existent nor non-existent. You are neither existing nor non-existing. Tvaṁ cāsatassataścānya, You are above existence and non-existence.

verses.iast: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān / api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase
verses.devanagari: सहस्रसूर्यकिरणाधिकशुद्धप्रकाशवान् / अपि त्वं सर्वभुवनव्यापको ऽपि न दृश्यसे
verses.english: Although, O Lord, You are more brilliant and shining (adhika śuddha prakāśavān) than sahasra sūryakiraṇā, than the simultaneous rise of the rays of one thousand suns, . . .

verses.iast: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ / vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān
verses.devanagari: जडे जगति चिद्रूपः किल वेद्ये ऽपि वेदकः / विभुर् मिते च येनासि तेन सर्वोत्तमो भवान्
verses.english: O Lord, as You are jaḍe jagati, in the unconscious world, in the world of unconsciousness, You are filled with consciousness. Jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ, in the unconscious world, You are filled with consciousness and filled with awareness. In the unaware world, You are aware.

verses.iast: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ / tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api
verses.devanagari: अलम् आक्रन्दितैर् अन्यैर् इयद् एव पुरः प्रभोः / तीव्रं विरौमि यन् नाथ मुह्याम्य् एवं विदन्न् अपि
verses.english: Let other lamentations, or weeping, or crying bitterly, ākranditaiḥ, let those remain untouched [i.e., ignored]. Let other lamentations and weeping for Thee, for Thyself, for achieving Thy nature, . . .

chapters.label: Chapter Four
chapters.title: Attachment for Lord Comes by Itself Surasodbalākhyāṁ caturthaṁ stotram

verses.iast: capalam asi yad api mānasa tatrāpi ślāghyase yato bhajase / śaraṇānām api śaraṇaṃ tribhuvanagurum ambikākāntam
verses.devanagari: चपलम् असि यद् अपि मानस तत्रापि श्लाघ्यसे यतो भजसे / शरणानाम् अपि शरणं त्रिभुवनगुरुम् अम्बिकाकान्तम्
verses.english: He calls his mind: “O mind, O my mind (mānasa), O my mind, capalamasi yadapi, although you are flickering, always you are restless, tatrāpi ślāghyase, even then you are glorified because, at times, whenever you direct your nature towards the remembrance of Lord Śiva, you direct it wholeheartedly. So, you are glorified. So, you are victorious. You are victorious because tribhuvanagurum, because you achieve the nearness of the Master of the three worlds.”

verses.iast: ullaṅghya vividhadaivatasopānakramam upeya śivacaraṇān / āśrityāpy adharatarāṃ bhūmiṃ nādyāpi citram ujjhāmi
verses.devanagari: उल्लङ्घ्य विविधदैवतसोपानक्रमम् उपेय शिवचरणान् / आश्रित्याप्य् अधरतरां भूमिं नाद्यापि चित्रम् उज्झामि
verses.english: O Lord, this is the great torture for me. This is the great story of torture for me.

verses.iast: prakaṭaya nijam adhvānaṃ sthagayatarām akhilalokacaritāni / yāvad bhavāmi bhagavaṃs tava sapadi sadodito dāsaḥ
verses.devanagari: प्रकटय निजम् अध्वानं स्थगयतराम् अखिललोकचरितानि / यावद् भवामि भगवंस् तव सपदि सदोदितो दासः
verses.english: Bhagavan, O Lord, O my Master, prakaṭaya nijamadhvānaṁ, keep Your ways open for me; keep Your ways, keep Your avenues, open for me. I don’t ask You to keep the avenues always open; just for the time being, as long as I would pass through them and reach at Your feet (prakaṭaya nijamadhvānaṁ). And, at the same time, simultaneously, sthagayatarām akhila lokacaritāni, and close all of the doors of this tortured . . . the world of torture, the world of differentiated perception, the world of hankering after sensual pleasures. Keep them closed for the time being, yāvad bhavāmi bhagavan, as long as I would become Your slave. Till then, You have to do these two things for me.

verses.iast: śiva śiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇāgatavatsalāśu kuru karuṇām / tava caraṇakamalayugalasmaraṇaparasya hi sampado 'dūre
verses.devanagari: शिव शिव शम्भो शङ्कर शरणागतवत्सलाशु कुरु करुणाम् / तव चरणकमलयुगलस्मरणपरस्य हि सम्पदो ऽदूरे
verses.english: O Lord Śiva, O Śambho, O Śaṅkara, O Śaraṇāgatavatsala, O [You who are] dear to those who have sought Your refuge (that is śaraṇāgatavatsala), āśu kuru karuṇām, keep Your karuṇā (dayā), keep Your grace on me in a speedy way. Don’t hesitate, don’t hesitate to bless me. Bless me soon, and now, āśukuru karuṇām, because, if You don’t bless me soon, I will be blessed automatically. I’ll be blessed automatically because I have got so much craving to get blessings from You that I can’t remain without it. I can’t live without Your grace! So, if You want to maintain Your honor and prestige, then You must bless me as soon as You can. Otherwise, I will be blessed naturally. I will be blessed because I am craving for that!

verses.iast: tāvakāṅghrikamalāsanalīnā ye yathāruci jagad racayanti / te viriñcim adhikāramalenāliptam asvavaśam īśa hasanti
verses.devanagari: तावकाङ्घ्रिकमलासनलीना ये यथारुचि जगद् रचयन्ति / ते विरिञ्चिम् अधिकारमलेनालिप्तम् अस्ववशम् ईश हसन्ति
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord (these are devotional songs), O Lord, those people . . .

verses.iast: tvatprakāśavapuṣo na vibhinnaṃ kiṃ cana prabhavati pratibhātum / tat sadaiva bhagavan parilabdho 'sīśvara prakṛtito 'pi vidūraḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वत्प्रकाशवपुषो न विभिन्नं किं चन प्रभवति प्रतिभातुम् / तत् सदैव भगवन् परिलब्धो ऽसीश्वर प्रकृतितो ऽपि विदूरः
verses.english: O Lord, nothing can exist if it is separated from Your glamorous form of cit (all consciousness, all knowledge, and all bliss). If anything is separated from that being of Yours, kiṁcana prabhavati pratibhātum, it cannot exist. So, everything, whatever exists, is one with that being of Your consciousness.

verses.iast: pādapaṅkajarasaṃ tava ke cid bhedaparyuṣitavṛttim upetāḥ / ke canāpi rasayanti tu sadhyo bhātam akṣatavapur dvayaśūnyam
verses.devanagari: पादपङ्कजरसं तव के चिद् भेदपर्युषितवृत्तिम् उपेताः / के चनापि रसयन्ति तु सध्यो भातम् अक्षतवपुर् द्वयशून्यम्
verses.english: Thine devotees are classified in two ways. Pādapankañjarasam, those who drink the nectar of Your lotus feet by sips, e.g., just [taking] one sip, then talk, then another sip, then do some other thing, then another sip . . . like that, successively. They drink in the nectar of Thine lotus feet . . .

verses.iast: nātha vidyud iva bhāti vibhāte yā kadā cana mamāmṛtadigdhā / sā yadi sthirataraiva bhavet tat pūjito 'si vidhivat kim utānyat
verses.devanagari: नाथ विद्युद् इव भाति विभाते या कदा चन ममामृतदिग्धा / सा यदि स्थिरतरैव भवेत् तत् पूजितो ऽसि विधिवत् किम् उतान्यत्
verses.english: Nātha, O Master, Your shining formation appears to me–That shining formation, which is soaked with nectar, soaked with the supreme nectar of joy, ecstasy; that is Your formation–and That [formation], already soaked with nectar, that formation of Thine appears to me sometimes, very seldom, not always.

verses.iast: sarvam asyaparam asti na kiṃ cid vastv avastu yadi veti mahatyā / prajñāya vyavasito 'tra yathaiva tvaṃ tathaiva bhava suprakaṭo me
verses.devanagari: सर्वम् अस्यपरम् अस्ति न किं चिद् वस्त्व् अवस्तु यदि वेति महत्या / प्रज्ञाय व्यवसितो ऽत्र यथैव त्वं तथैव भव सुप्रकटो मे
verses.english: In fact, from the Shaivite point of view, You are everywhere. This is one hundred percent truth that You are everywhere (sarvamasi). And You are residing in every object, each and every object. You are there always. Na kiṁcit, there is nothing existing except You. This is a fact. This is a fact discussed and proved in Shaivism. Prajñayā vyavasthito’tra yathaiva, and this I have noticed, this I have concluded, that this is the real fact, that You are everywhere, You are everything, You are residing in each and every object, but why don’t You appear like that to me? I would like You to appear like that. It is only theory. Theoretically, I understand it but it must appear to me practically. That is what I long for.

verses.iast: svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam ahaṃ prabhunaiva / tat kathaṃ janavad eva carāmi tvatpadocitam avaimi na kiṃ cit
verses.devanagari: स्वेच्छयैव भगवन् निजमार्गे कारितः पदम् अहं प्रभुनैव / तत् कथं जनवद् एव चरामि त्वत्पदोचितम् अवैमि न किं चित्
verses.english: Svecchayaiva bhagavannijamārge, I have never told You to put me on the roadside, on the path of Your abode, Your spiritual abode. I never told You . . . I never asked You to carry me on the path of Yours. You have done it Yourself! Kāritaḥ padamahaṁ prabhuṇaiva, You have put me on the path and now You are refusing to appear.

verses.iast: ko 'pi deva hṛdi teṣu tāvako jṛmbhate subhagabhāva uttamaḥ / tvatkathāmbudaninādacātakā yena te 'pi subhagīkṛtāś ciram
verses.devanagari: को ऽपि देव हृदि तेषु तावको जृम्भते सुभगभाव उत्तमः / त्वत्कथाम्बुदनिनादचातका येन ते ऽपि सुभगीकृताश् चिरम्
verses.english: But this is the greatness of Thine, O Lord, O Master, that in those hearts of those blessed devotees of Thine, that fineness of Thy devotion is perceived, appears. That fineness of Thy devotion appears in the hearts of those people–that kind of fineness. Although they are away from that consciousness of Thine, but when some other person explains the fineness of Yours before them–some other person explains, puts forth, the fineness of Your joy and Your bliss and they hear–. . .

verses.iast: tvajjuṣāṃ tvayi kayāpi līlayā rāga eṣa paripoṣam āgataḥ / yad viyogabhuvi saṅkathā tathā saṃsmṛtiḥ phalati saṃgamotsavam
verses.devanagari: त्वज्जुषां त्वयि कयापि लीलया राग एष परिपोषम् आगतः / यद् वियोगभुवि सङ्कथा तथा संस्मृतिः फलति संगमोत्सवम्
verses.english: Tvajjuṣām, those devotees of Thine, in those devotees of Thine, kayāpi līlayā, by the divine grace of Thine, the rāga, the attachment for Thee, is so much intense in those devotees of Thine. [This occurs] not by their actions, not by their continuous practice of yoga, but how?

verses.iast: yo vicitrarasasekavardhitaḥ śaṅkareti śataśo 'py udīritaḥ / śabda āviśati tiryagāśayeṣv apy ayaṃ navanavaprayojanaḥ
verses.devanagari: यो विचित्ररससेकवर्धितः शङ्करेति शतशो ऽप्य् उदीरितः / शब्द आविशति तिर्यगाशयेष्व् अप्य् अयं नवनवप्रयोजनः
verses.english: When this sound, this sound “Śiva” is recited one hundred times–“Śaṅkarā, Śaṅkarā, Śaṅkarā, Śaṅkarā . . . ”, like that, one hundred times–and this sound āviśati tiryagāśayeṣu, this sound enters in the heart of the animal world, the animal kingdom . . .

verses.iast: te jayanti mukhamaṇḍale bhraman asti yeṣu niyataṃ śivadhvaniḥ / yaḥ śāśīva prasṛto 'mṛtāśayāt svādu saṃsravati cāmṛtaṃ param
verses.devanagari: ते जयन्ति मुखमण्डले भ्रमन् अस्ति येषु नियतं शिवध्वनिः / यः शाशीव प्रसृतो ऽमृताशयात् स्वादु संस्रवति चामृतं परम्
verses.english: Now, those persons on whose lips this sound “Śiva” is residing twenty-four hours–this “Śiva” is residing [on their lips] for twenty-four hours [a day], while walking, doing everything, talking, bathing, eating, drinking, meditating, not meditating–and they feel that this sound is appearing to them on their lips always . . .

verses.iast: parisamāptam ivogram idaṃ jagad vigalito 'viralo manaso malaḥ / tad api nāsti bhavatpurārgalakavāṭavighaṭṭanam aṇva pi
verses.devanagari: परिसमाप्तम् इवोग्रम् इदं जगद् विगलितो ऽविरलो मनसो मलः / तद् अपि नास्ति भवत्पुरार्गलकवाटविघट्टनम् अण्व पि
verses.english: O Lord, this whole universe of differentiated perception–e.g., he is Bruce Hughes, he is John Hughes, she is another Hughes, and he is Pollack, he is everything–this differentiated perception, this world of differentiated perception, has totally come to its end. It is a fact, to me. To me, I feel that this differentiated perception is over, for good. So there is nothing applicable for that. Vigalito’viralo manaso malaḥ, and the internal impurity of āṇavamala (that subtle impurity, that is āṇavamala), that, too, is also finished, to me. The differentiated perception, the mode of differentiated perception is also finished.94

verses.iast: satataphullabhavanmukhapaṅkajodaravilokanalālasacetasaḥ / kim api tat kuru nātha manāg iva sphurasi yena mamābhimukhasthitiḥ
verses.devanagari: सततफुल्लभवन्मुखपङ्कजोदरविलोकनलालसचेतसः / किम् अपि तत् कुरु नाथ मनाग् इव स्फुरसि येन ममाभिमुखस्थितिः
verses.english: O Lord, I have got only one craving and longing. My mind longs and craves for–for what?–bhavad mukha paṅkaja udara vilokana, just to see the depth of Your mouth, the depth of Your face; just to see and get entry in the depth of Your face, That face which is satataphulla, which is blooming always, not like lotuses [that bloom] only in the daytime and at night they are closed–Thine lotus-shaped mukha (face) is always blooming. It is a lotus, day and night–blooming lotus. And I have got only this much craving in my mind, just to see in the center of That lotus, just to go on observing the depth of that lotus of Your face. So, this craving and this longing is there always. So, do something for me! Kimapi tat kuru, do something, somehow, at any cost. Do that thing.

verses.iast: tvadavibhedamater aparaṃ nu kiṃ sukham ihāsti vibhūtir athāparā / tad iha tāvakadāsajanasya kiṃ kupatham eti manaḥ parihṛtya tām
verses.devanagari: त्वदविभेदमतेर् अपरं नु किं सुखम् इहास्ति विभूतिर् अथापरा / तद् इह तावकदासजनस्य किं कुपथम् एति मनः परिहृत्य ताम्
verses.english: This is a fact, O Lord, this is a fact, this is an admitted fact, that when tvad abhedamateḥ, when that conclusive perception comes, appears in one’s mind, . . .

verses.iast: kṣaṇam apīha na tāvakadāsatāṃ prati bhaveyam ahaṃ kila bhājanam / bhavadabhedarasāsavam ādarād avirataṃ rasayeyam ahaṃ na cet
verses.devanagari: क्षणम् अपीह न तावकदासतां प्रति भवेयम् अहं किल भाजनम् / भवदभेदरसासवम् आदराद् अविरतं रसयेयम् अहं न चेत्
verses.english: If I would not have tasted the nectar of Thy glorious feet, lotus-like feet–abheda rasam, that is abheda rasam, the oneness of that rasa–if that oneness of rasa I would not have tasted with great honor, with great love, with affection, and in continuity, . . .

verses.iast: na kila paśyati satyam ayaṃ janas tava vapur dvayadṛṣṭimalīmasaḥ / tad api sarvavidāśritavatsalaḥ kim idam āraṭitaṃ na śṛṇoṣi me
verses.devanagari: न किल पश्यति सत्यम् अयं जनस् तव वपुर् द्वयदृष्टिमलीमसः / तद् अपि सर्वविदाश्रितवत्सलः किम् इदम् आरटितं न शृणोषि मे
verses.english: It is true. I confess it, my Lord. It is true and I confess it, that these worldly people (ayaṁ janaḥ, these people) are given to worldly pleasures, dvaya dṛṣṭi malīmasaḥ, and they are made impure; they are made impure by the impurity of differentiated perception of worldly . . . differentiated worldly perception of worldly joys. It is true.

verses.iast: smarasi nātha kadācid apīhitaṃ viṣayasaukhyam athāpi mayārthitam / satatam eva bhavadvapurīkṣaṇāmṛtamabhīṣṭamalaṃ mama dehi tat
verses.devanagari: स्मरसि नाथ कदाचिद् अपीहितं विषयसौख्यम् अथापि मयार्थितम् / सततम् एव भवद्वपुरीक्षणामृतमभीष्टमलं मम देहि तत्
verses.english: Smarasi nātha kadācidapīhitaṁ. Just remember, my Lord, just remember, just think and go deep in previous [thoughts and actions] of mine, think and see if there was any moment when I have longed and craved for worldly enjoyments; if there is a day, there is a moment, there is one moment, that kind of one moment at which moment I have acted or longed for worldly pleasures. You won’t find any moment like that! I have always been asking for Your love, for Your nearness, for Your . . . I want to get entry in You. I have nothing else. In this world, I have no taste. I don’t feel anything, just only You.

verses.iast: kila yadaiva śivādhvani tāvake kṛtapado 'smi maheśa tavecchayā / śubhaśatānyuditāni tadaiva me kim aparaṃ mṛgaye bhavataḥ prabho
verses.devanagari: किल यदैव शिवाध्वनि तावके कृतपदो ऽस्मि महेश तवेच्छया / शुभशतान्युदितानि तदैव मे किम् अपरं मृगये भवतः प्रभो
verses.english: Prabho, O Master, yadaiva tāvake śivādhvani, O Master, O my Lord (maheśvara means “O my Lord”; prabho means “O my Master”), O my Master, O my Lord, at that moment, when I have been made to step on the path of Your supreme nectar, when I have stepped on the path of Your abode (śivādhvani, the path of śiva bhāva), I have not stepped on That path myself. Tavecchayā, it was Your desire that I should step on That path.

verses.iast: yatra so 'stam ayam eti vivasvāṃś candramaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ saha sarvaiḥ / kāpi sā vijayate śivarātriḥ svaprabhāprasarabhāsvararūpā
verses.devanagari: यत्र सो ऽस्तम् अयम् एति विवस्वांश् चन्द्रमः प्रभृतिभिः सह सर्वैः / कापि सा विजयते शिवरात्रिः स्वप्रभाप्रसरभास्वररूपा
verses.english: Where that stage, that place, that abode of Your ‘nectarized’ residence, where astamayameti vivasvān, this functioning of the sun stops altogether, the sun does not function . . .

verses.iast: apy upārjitam ahaṃ triṣu lokeṣv adhipatyam amareśvara manye / nīrasaṃ tad akhilaṃ bhavadaṅghrisparśanāmṛtarasena vihīnam
verses.devanagari: अप्य् उपार्जितम् अहं त्रिषु लोकेष्व् अधिपत्यम् अमरेश्वर मन्ये / नीरसं तद् अखिलं भवदङ्घ्रिस्पर्शनामृतरसेन विहीनम्
verses.english: Amareśvara, O God of gods, O God of all gods (amareśvara means “who is the God of all gods, who is the master of all gods”), if I have attained and achieved and possessed a kingdom in all of the three worlds, if I possess the state of a kingdom of all the three worlds, even then, that whole kingdom appears to me as rubbish. That kingdom appears to me as rubbish and without any taste.

verses.iast: bata nātha dṛḍho 'yam ātmabandho bhavadakhyātimayas tvayaiva kḷptaḥ / yad ayaṃ prathamānam eva me tvām avadhīrya ślathate na leśato 'pi
verses.devanagari: बत नाथ दृढो ऽयम् आत्मबन्धो भवदख्यातिमयस् त्वयैव कॢप्तः / यद् अयं प्रथमानम् एव मे त्वाम् अवधीर्य श्लथते न लेशतो ऽपि
verses.english: Nātha, O my Master, this is the greatest worry in me.

verses.iast: mahatām amareśa pūjyamāno 'py aniśaṃ tiṣṭhasi pūjakaikarūpaḥ / bahirantarapīha dṛśyamānaḥ sphurasi draṣṭṛśarīra eva śaśvat
verses.devanagari: महताम् अमरेश पूज्यमानो ऽप्य् अनिशं तिष्ठसि पूजकैकरूपः / बहिरन्तरपीह दृश्यमानः स्फुरसि द्रष्टृशरीर एव शश्वत्
verses.english: O God of gods, there is one thing, which is unique regarding Your nature when You are worshiped by great souls. When great souls worship You and You are worshiped by those great souls, You take the seat of being the worshiper, not the worshiped. There, You are the worshiper, not the worshiped. If You are worshiped by those great souls, when they worship You, You are worshiped, actually You are worshiped, but, in fact, You are the worshiper Yourself. You are the worshiper.

chapters.label: Chapter Five
chapters.title: Longing for the Strength of Ones’s Own Nature Svabalanideśanākhyaṁ pañcamaṁ stotram

verses.iast: tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam / galepādikayā nātha māṃ svaveśma praveśaya
verses.devanagari: त्वत्पादपद्मसम्पर्कमात्रसम्भोगसङ्गिनम् / गलेपादिकया नाथ मां स्ववेश्म प्रवेशय
verses.english: O Master, tvatpādapadma samparkamātra saṁbhogasaṅginam, I am always attached to Your lotus feet. As You know that I am attached to Your lotus feet and this is my weakness–I have no other weakness in this world [except] only this weakness that I want to be near Your lotus feet, to be attached with Your lotus feet–but I can’t reach there. The problem is, I can’t reach there. How can I reach? How can individuality get entry in universality? Individual consciousness can never reach universal consciousness. So, there is no hope for me to reach there and to be near Your lotus feet. So, there is one request. You should fulfill that, my Lord. That is, galepadikayā nātha māṁ svaveśma praveśaya, drag me to that abode of Thine [regardless of] my desires also, i.e., if I don’t want it, if I have no strength to go there, [still] You [must] carry me, drag me there, at once.

verses.iast: bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ / apārarabhasārabdhanartanaḥ syām ahaṃ kadā
verses.devanagari: भवत्पादाम्बुजरजोराजिरञ्जितमूर्धजः / अपाररभसारब्धनर्तनः स्याम् अहं कदा
verses.english: When will that glorious day come to me, my Lord, when bhavatpādāmbujarajo rājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ, I will be with You, I will remain with You and Your lotus feet, and I will take Your lotus feet, hold Your lotus feet, and take off the dust from Your lotus feet, and that dust I would apply on my head and hair wholeheartedly and apārarabhasaḥ, and I will get intoxicated in fullness and I would dance? I would dance always when that glorious day will come to me.

verses.iast: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā / tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वद् एकनाथो भगवन्न् इयद् एवार्थये सदा / त्वदन्तर्वसतिर् मूको भवेयं मान्यथा बुधः
verses.english: I have only one master and that is Thyself (tvadekanātha). I have nothing. I know nobody else. I know You. You are my master. You are everything to me! You are my wife, You are my husband, You are my father, You are my mother, You are my everything! You are my attaché. You are everything to me!

verses.iast: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana / aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan
verses.devanagari: अहो सुधानिधे स्वामिन्न् अहो मृष्ट त्रिलोचन / अहो स्वादो विरूपक्षेत्य् एव नृत्येयम् आरटन्
verses.english: I wish to dance! I wish to dance wholeheartedly. I crave to dance wholeheartedly and I would like to sing with sounds, clear sounds.

verses.iast: tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ / vijṛmbheyabhavadbhaktimadirāmadaghūrṇitaḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वत्पादपद्मसंस्पर्शपरिमीलितलोचनः / विजृम्भेयभवद्भक्तिमदिरामदघूर्णितः
verses.english: I would like to drink, taste the liquor of Your devotion102. The liquor of Your devotion, I would like to taste. When I would taste the liquor of Your devotion, and by that devotion, ghūrṇitaḥ, I would get intoxicated–I would like to get intoxicated–and then, tvatpādapadmasaṁsparśaḥ, and I would be near Your lotus feet. And by the touch of Your lotus feet, parimīlitalocanaḥ, my eyes would be closed altogether and I would be intoxicated for twenty-four hours [a day]. Like that, I wish that.

verses.iast: cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā / nirantaratvatpralāpamayī vṛttir mahārasā
verses.devanagari: चित्तभूभृद् भुवि विभो वसेयं क्वापि यत्र सा / निरन्तरत्वत्प्रलापमयी वृत्तिर् महारसा
verses.english: O Lord, I would like one thing: I would like to reside in the secluded, isolated place, of that mountain of the mind; some isolated place of the mind, I would like to reside in that. Isolated place of the mountain of the mind, on the peak of the mountain, there would be that isolated place of that mind where there are no other thoughts coming. There I would like to reside.

verses.iast: yatra devīsametas tvam āsaudhādā ca gopurāt / bahurūpaḥ sthitas tasmin vāstavyaḥ syām ahaṃ pure
verses.devanagari: यत्र देवीसमेतस् त्वम् आसौधादा च गोपुरात् / बहुरूपः स्थितस् तस्मिन् वास्तव्यः स्याम् अहं पुरे
verses.english: O Lord, where You reside along with Your better half, where You are residing along with Your better half, Pārvatī, not only in the secluded place of samādhi, not only in the secluded place of Your residential abode of God consciousness, no, from That point to ā ca gopurāt, up to the point of vaikharī103, up to the point of worldly activities, I wish You [would] appear to me along with Your Pārvatī, right from samādhi to worldly activities.

verses.iast: samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ / vikasatveṣa yāvan me hṛtpadmaḥ pūjanāya te
verses.devanagari: समुल्लसन्तु भगवन् भवद्भानुमरीचयः / विकसत्वेष यावन् मे हृत्पद्मः पूजनाय ते
verses.english: I want to give You one trouble only, only for . . . not always, not for always. I am troubling You only for some considerable period. That is . . .

verses.iast: prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā / mano me tattadāsvādya kṣīved iva galed iva
verses.devanagari: प्रसीद भगवन् येन त्वत्पदे पतितं सदा / मनो मे तत्तदास्वाद्य क्षीवेद् इव गलेद् इव
verses.english: O Lord, be pleased with me. And, by that, what will happen? Tvatpade patitaṁ sadā, my mind [will] always be at Your lotus feet. Let You be pleased with my mind, and when it is . . . when Your pleasure, Your joy, will penetrate my mind, what will happen in my mind? Tattadāsvādya, my mind will experience many of those many supernatural states of being, and my mind will get intoxicated, and my mind will get dissolved in some supreme Being. So, let You be pleased with my mind in that way.

verses.iast: praharṣād vātha śokād vā yadi kuṅyād dhaṭād api / bāhyād athāntarād bhāvāt prakaṭībhava me prabho
verses.devanagari: प्रहर्षाद् वाथ शोकाद् वा यदि कुङ्याद् धटाद् अपि / बाह्याद् अथान्तराद् भावात् प्रकटीभव मे प्रभो
verses.english: O my Master, appear to me! I don’t mind if You appear to me in happiness, by giving happiness. If I am happy and You appear to me, well and good. If I am in crisis and You appear to me, well and good. Let me remain in crisis, but appear to me! Śokādvā, if I am grieved, totally grieved, if I have lost all of my relatives, all of my kith and kin, and I am discarded from all of my company, and You appear to me, well and good. Praharṣādvātha śokādvā yadi kuḍyād, if You appear to me from a wall, well and good; ghaṭādapi, if You appear to me from some pot, well and good; bāhyāt, if You appear to me from outside, well and good; antarādbhāvāt, if You appear to me from inside, well and good.

verses.iast: bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me / bhavatpādāmbujasparśāmṛtam atyantaśītalam
verses.devanagari: बहिर् अप्य् अन्तर् अपि तत् स्यन्दमानं सदास्तु मे / भवत्पादाम्बुजस्पर्शामृतम् अत्यन्तशीतलम्
verses.english: Bhavatpāda ambuja sparśa amṛtam. The nectar, which appears by the touch of Your divine lotus feet–that nectar that rises from the touch of Your lotus feet–and that nectar which is atyanta śītalam, soothing and very cooling–the touch of Your lotus feet, the nectar of that touch of Your lotus feet, is very soothing and cooling–O Lord, bahirapyantarapi tat syandamānaṁ sadāstu me, let that divine nectar remain flowing outside and inside to me always–that nectar.

verses.iast: tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam / ko 'py eṣa sarvasambhogalaṅghī bhogo 'stu me sadā
verses.devanagari: त्वत्पादसंस्पर्शसुधासरसो ऽन्तर्निमज्जनम् / को ऽप्य् एष सर्वसम्भोगलङ्घी भोगो ऽस्तु मे सदा
verses.english: I would like to have that enjoyment, that unique enjoyment, that unique pleasure. I would like to have that unique pleasure, always.

verses.iast: niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā / ādāya cāmṛtīkṛtya bhuṅkṣva bhaktajanaiḥ samam
verses.devanagari: निवेदितम् उपादत्स्व रागादि भगवन् मया / आदाय चामृतीकृत्य भुङ्क्ष्व भक्तजनैः समम्
verses.english: O Lord, I have come to You. I am before You at Your feet. I have got some present for You. I have carried some present for You. Would you accept it?

verses.iast: aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam / svāmin gṛhāṇa dāseṣu prasādālokanakṣaṇam
verses.devanagari: अशेषभुवनाहारनित्यतृप्तः सुखासनम् / स्वामिन् गृहाण दासेषु प्रसादालोकनक्षणम्
verses.english: Now, You will say, O Lord, that You have so much to do, “I can’t attend to you so soon”. O Lord, if You will say that, that You have so much to do, that You have got worldly matters, so many things to be done, so many things to be adjusted, but, in fact, You have done all those things, aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ, because You are always full. Your stomach is always full because this whole universe is Your own food. You have already possessed that. Sukhāsanam, You are seated peacefully now. So, what is the harm if You don’t [neglect to] hear my demand?

verses.iast: antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ / namo mahyaṃ śivāyeti pūjayam syāṃ tṛṇāny api
verses.devanagari: अन्तर्भक्तिचमत्कारचर्वणामीलितेक्षणः / नमो मह्यं शिवायेति पूजयम् स्यां तृणान्य् अपि
verses.english: O Lord, I would like to have that state, that supreme state, when antar bhakti camatkāra carvaṇa āmīlitekṣaṇā, I would be experiencing the internal joy of God consciousness, internal joy of Your nearness. And, by experiencing that internal joy, all of my organs would [become] closed (mīlitekṣanā). And then, namo mahyaṁ śivāyeti–then I would be doing what?–namo mahyaṁ śivāyeti, let prostrations be to my own Self, prostrations be to my own Self. In this way, I would like to prostrate before my own nature and I would be worshiping even blades of grass in this universe. Everything I would like to worship afterwards.

verses.iast: api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ svātmollāsamayaṃ jagat / paśyan bhaktirasābhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ
verses.devanagari: अपि लब्धभवद्भावः स्वात्मोल्लासमयं जगत् / पश्यन् भक्तिरसाभोगैर् भवेयम् अवियोजितः
verses.english: When that day will come (api means “when that day, when that glorious day will come to me”), when that glorious day will come to me when svātma ullāsam ayaṁ jagat paśyan, I would perceive this whole universe as the outcome of my own nature’s glory, bhakti rasā bhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ, and I will become one with that ecstasy, ecstasy of bhaktirasa, ecstasy of tasting the nectar of devotion. I would be one with . . . in tasting the ecstasy of Your devotion when that day will come to me.

verses.iast: ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate / tava tenādvitīyasya yuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā
verses.devanagari: आकाम्क्षणीयम् अपरं येन नाथ न विद्यते / तव तेनाद्वितीयस्य युक्तं यत् परिपूर्णता
verses.english: O Lord, śāstras (scriptures) hold that You are full, You are always full. I think it is a fact. I think it is a fact that You are always full because ākāṅkṣaṇīyam aparaṁ, full is that person who has nothing to do, who has nothing to seek, who has nothing to get, who has nothing to achieve–he is full.

verses.iast: hasyate nṛtyate yatra rāgadveṣādi bhujyate / pīyate bhaktipīyūṣarasas tat prāpnuyāṃ padam
verses.devanagari: हस्यते नृत्यते यत्र रागद्वेषादि भुज्यते / पीयते भक्तिपीयूषरसस् तत् प्राप्नुयां पदम्
verses.english: O Lord, I would like to achieve that state of being where hasyate, You are filled with laughter, where You are filled with laughter, You always laugh, nṛtyati, You always dance, rāgadveṣādi bhujyate, You always eat the craving of worldly enjoyments“at” means subsiding; “eating worldly enjoyments” means subsiding worldly enjoyments).

verses.iast: tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā dṛḍhatām / etu mama manasi yāvann aśyatu durvāsanāgandhaḥ
verses.devanagari: तत् तद् अपूर्वामोदत्वच्चिन्ताकुसुमवासना दृढताम् / एतु मम मनसि यावन्न् अश्यतु दुर्वासनागन्धः
verses.english: O Master, in my mind there is a foul smell, always. In my mind, in the space of my mind, there is always a foul smell. And that “foul smell” means that durvāsanā, various thoughts, various desires of life, e.g., I would like to go there, I would like to do this, that, swimming, attending movies, music, everything. And all of these desires have created a hell in my mind. They have created a hell of a bad smell. This is a bad smell.

verses.iast: kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam / itthaṃ virodharasikaṃ bodhaya hitam amara me hṛdayam
verses.devanagari: क्व नु रागादिषु रागः क्व च हरचरणाम्बुजेषु रागित्वम् / इत्थं विरोधरसिकं बोधय हितम् अमर मे हृदयम्
verses.english: Amara, O divine Lord, my mind, I know my mind, it is virodharasikaṁ; virodharasikaṁ, sometimes [my mind] likes to be [involved] in the enjoyment of worldly pleasures, sometimes [my mind] wants to meditate. Sometimes it happens in my mind, just this desire comes just to meditate wholeheartedly on that one-pointedness. Sometimes it appears in my mind just to go after worldly pleasures, worldly enjoyments. But this is North Pole and South Pole. There is no meeting of these things; they don’t meet. How can they meet? This is North Pole and this is South Pole.

verses.iast: vicaran yogadaśāsv api viṣayavyāvṛttivartamāno 'pi / tvaccintāmadirāmadataralīkṛtahṛdaya eva syām
verses.devanagari: विचरन् योगदशास्व् अपि विषयव्यावृत्तिवर्तमानो ऽपि / त्वच्चिन्तामदिरामदतरलीकृतहृदय एव स्याम्
verses.english: Vicaran yoga daśāsvapi. Although I am roaming in the various states of yoga, although I am bent upon depriving my mind from attachment towards worldly pleasures–I am doing that; I am extracting my mind from worldly enjoyments and I am roaming in the states of yoga–I am doing this, it is true, but I don’t like this kind of struggle.

verses.iast: vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu karaṇaracitāsu / sarvatra sarvadā me puraḥsaro bhavatu bhaktirasaḥ
verses.devanagari: वाचि मनोमतिषु तथा शरीरचेष्टासु करणरचितासु / सर्वत्र सर्वदा मे पुरःसरो भवतु भक्तिरसः
verses.english: O Lord, I would like to have this [one] thing.

verses.iast: śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi nātha japyamāne 'smin / āsvādayan bhaveyaṃ kam api mahārasam apunaruktam
verses.devanagari: शिवशिवशिवेति नामनि तव निरवधि नाथ जप्यमाने ऽस्मिन् / आस्वादयन् भवेयं कम् अपि महारसम् अपुनरुक्तम्
verses.english: Nātha, O my Master, I would like to have this [one] thing.

verses.iast: sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape parinipītasamastajaḍādhvani / agaṇitāparacinmayagaṇḍike pravicareyam ahaṃ bhavato 'rcitā
verses.devanagari: स्फुरदनन्तचिदात्मकविष्टपे परिनिपीतसमस्तजडाध्वनि / अगणितापरचिन्मयगण्डिके प्रविचरेयम् अहं भवतो ऽर्चिता
verses.english: O Lord, I would like to reside, I would like to live, in that country, I would like to live in that country–in which country?–sphurad ananta cidātmaka viṣṭape, which country is filled with numberless hutments of God consciousness.

verses.iast: svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate sthitikṛte na kim apy upayujyate / iti matiḥ sudṛḍhā bhavatāt paraṃ mama bhavaccaraṇābjarajaḥ śuceḥ
verses.devanagari: स्ववपुषि स्फुटभासिनि शाश्वते स्थितिकृते न किम् अप्य् उपयुज्यते / इति मतिः सुदृढा भवतात् परं मम भवच्चरणाब्जरजः शुचेः
verses.english: It is a fact–there is no doubt in this understanding–that Your nature, when It is sphuṭa bhāsini, when It appears clearly, when It appears clearly to anybody, . . .

verses.iast: kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati tad bhavadaṃghritalaspṛśām / galati yatra samastamidaṃ sudhāsarasi viśvam idaṃ diśa me sadā
verses.devanagari: किम् अपि नाथ कदाचन चेतसि स्फुरति तद् भवदंघ्रितलस्पृशाम् / गलति यत्र समस्तमिदं सुधासरसि विश्वम् इदं दिश मे सदा
verses.english: Nātha, O my Master, bhavat aṅghritala spṛśam, those fortunate souls who are always residing near Thy lotus feet, those fortunate ones who are always residing near Your lotus feet, in those minds, in the minds of those fortunate people who reside near Your lotus feet, something happens to them, which I cannot explain. Something unique happens to them in their minds; in their minds, something flows out. And, by which thing, by which flow, galati yatra samastamidaṁ sudhā sarasi, where all other worries of the world are shattered to pieces and dissolved in that supreme ocean of nectar. Give me that, please. I would like to achieve that.

chapters.label: Chapter Six
chapters.title: Clearance of the Path

verses.iast: kṣaṇamātram apīśāna viyuktasya tvayā mama / nibiḍaṃ tapyamānasya sadā bhūyā dṛśaḥ padam
verses.devanagari: क्षणमात्रम् अपीशान वियुक्तस्य त्वया मम / निबिडं तप्यमानस्य सदा भूया दृशः पदम्
verses.english: Īśāna, O Lord, mama tvayā viyuktasya, when I become separated from Your Self, kṣaṇamātram api, even for one second–when I become separated, when I am placed away from You even for one second, one moment–nibiḍaṁ tapyamānasya, You must understand that I catch fire of sadness, at once. I am burnt in the fire of sadness at that moment.

verses.iast: viyogasāre saṃsāre priyeṇa prabhuṇā tvayā / aviyuktaḥ sadaiva syāṃ jagatāpi viyojitaḥ
verses.devanagari: वियोगसारे संसारे प्रियेण प्रभुणा त्वया / अवियुक्तः सदैव स्यां जगतापि वियोजितः
verses.english: It is a fact that this world (saṁsāre), this world is viyogasāre, it is to be . . . there is separation in the end. In this universe, there is separation. You are being separated from your kith and kin. You have to . . . viyogasāre saṁsāre, this saṁsāre, the essence of this world, is to [experience] separation. Separation will take place in the end. Everybody will be separated.

verses.iast: kāyavāṅmanasair yatra yāmi sarvaṃ tvam eva tat / ity eṣa paramārtho 'pi paripūrṇo 'stu me sadā
verses.devanagari: कायवाङ्मनसैर् यत्र यामि सर्वं त्वम् एव तत् / इत्य् एष परमार्थो ऽपि परिपूर्णो ऽस्तु मे सदा
verses.english: Ityeṣa paramārtho’pi. This is the real science of our philosophy, ityeṣa paramārtho’pi, this is our true philosophy, that wherever I go, yatra yāmi, wherever I go through body, through speech, or through mind, wherever I go, wherever I move (kāya means “through body”, vāṅ means “through speech”, manasaiḥ means “through mind”), wherever I move, in fact, sarvaṁ tvameva tat, in fact, that place is always one with Thee. Sarvaṁ tvameva tat, wherever I move, e.g., if I move to a picture house, that picture house is one with [Thee]. I am not away from Thy presence there. Wherever I go, wherever my body goes, wherever my speech goes, whatever my speech says, whatever my mind thinks, that is Your nature, that is Your divine Self. This is the reality of our philosophy. Ityeṣa paramārtho’pi, this is the reality. It is a fact that this is the reality. Paripūrṇo’stu me sadā, but I don’t get satisfaction. I would like to get satisfaction in this understanding. I understand this is true, but this does not appear to me practically. I want this to appear in practical shape.

verses.iast: nirvikalpo mahānandapūrṇo yadvad bhavāṃs tathā / bhavatstutikarī bhūyād anurūpaiva vāṅ mama
verses.devanagari: निर्विकल्पो महानन्दपूर्णो यद्वद् भवांस् तथा / भवत्स्तुतिकरी भूयाद् अनुरूपैव वाङ् मम
verses.english: O Lord, You are nirvikalpa, You have no vikalpas.111 Mahānanda pūrṇa, You are filled with supreme ecstasy. This is the reality of Your nature. You are nirvikalpa and You are filled with supreme ecstasy, always.

verses.iast: bhavadāveśataḥ paśyan bhāvaṃ bhāvaṃ bhavanmayam / vicareyaṃ nirākāṅkṣaḥ praharṣaparipūritaḥ
verses.devanagari: भवदावेशतः पश्यन् भावं भावं भवन्मयम् / विचरेयं निराकाङ्क्षः प्रहर्षपरिपूरितः
verses.english: Paripūritaḥ, I would wish one thing, bas. Just as a ghost enters into somebody and that person becomes one with the ghost, he talks like the ghost afterwards, . . .

verses.iast: bhagavanbhavataḥ pūrṇam paśyeyam akhilaṃ jagat / tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭas tato na parikhidyase
verses.devanagari: भगवन्भवतः पूर्णम् पश्येयम् अखिलं जगत् / तावतैवास्मि सन्तुष्टस् ततो न परिखिद्यसे
verses.english: Bhagavan, O Lord, there is one desire in me, which always knocks in the background of my consciousness, and that is, I would like to perceive this whole universe filled with Your consciousness, filled with Your supreme consciousness. This whole universe, I would like to perceive already filled with supreme consciousness. Tāvataivāsmi santuṣṭaḥ, that is my ambition. That, my ambition, will be completed that way. I take an oath, my Lord, then I won’t trouble You further. Afterwards, I won’t trouble You. I won’t give You any trouble in asking for more and more things. This is the only one thing that I ask, once and for all. Let me see this whole universe as one with Thee and I will be satisfied. I won’t trouble You any more afterwards.

verses.iast: vilīyamānās tvayy eva vyomni meghalavā iva / bhāvā vibhāntu me śaśvat kramanairmalyagāminaḥ
verses.devanagari: विलीयमानास् त्वय्य् एव व्योम्नि मेघलवा इव / भावा विभान्तु मे शश्वत् क्रमनैर्मल्यगामिनः
verses.english: Let me feel this objective world, this universe of objectivity, as it is lying in the ether of Your God consciousness; in the ether of Your consciousness, just like clouds. As clouds . . . as there are heaps of clouds in the sky, in the same way, let me feel this universal world as masses of clouds in the sky of God consciousness, in the sky of God consciousness.

verses.iast: svaprabhāprasaradhvastāparyantadhvāntasantatiḥ / santataṃ bhātu me ko 'pi bhavamadhyād bhavanmaṇiḥ
verses.devanagari: स्वप्रभाप्रसरध्वस्तापर्यन्तध्वान्तसन्ततिः / सन्ततं भातु मे को ऽपि भवमध्याद् भवन्मणिः
verses.english: Svaprabhā prasara, O Lord, I have this desire that when, by the effulgent light of Your consciousness, the effulgent light of Your flow of consciousness, dhvasta aparyanta dhvānta santatiḥ, all of my ignorance, all of the masses of ignorance, . . .

verses.iast: kāṃ bhūmikāṃ nādhiśeṣe kiṃ tat syād yan na te vapuḥ / śrāntas tenāprayāsena sarvatas tvām avāpnuyām
verses.devanagari: कां भूमिकां नाधिशेषे किं तत् स्याद् यन् न ते वपुः / श्रान्तस् तेनाप्रयासेन सर्वतस् त्वाम् अवाप्नुयाम्
verses.english: O Lord, what is that stage, which You don’t possess? All stages are possessed by Thee. Kiṁ tat syāt yanna, and what is that formation, which is not Your formation? All formations are possessed by You. All forms of You are Yours.

verses.iast: bhavadaṅgapariṣvaṅgasambhogaḥ svecchayaiva me / ghaṭatām iyati prāpte kiṃ nātha na jitaṃ mayā
verses.devanagari: भवदङ्गपरिष्वङ्गसम्भोगः स्वेच्छयैव मे / घटताम् इयति प्राप्ते किं नाथ न जितं मया
verses.english: Nātha, O Master, just by my will112–not by action–just when I desire, bhavadaṅga parisvaṅga saṁbhogaḥ, let the joy of becoming embraced with Thee appear automatically. I don’t want to embrace You. You must embrace me! This is what I desire. Bhavat aṅga pariṣvaṅga saṁbhogaḥ svecchayaiva me ghaṭatām, not by embracing, but by being embraced. I must get embraced by You.113

verses.iast: prakaṭībhava nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ / kurmas te nātha tāmyantas tvām eva mṛgayāmahe
verses.devanagari: प्रकटीभव नान्याभिः प्रार्थनाभिः कदर्थनाः / कुर्मस् ते नाथ ताम्यन्तस् त्वाम् एव मृगयामहे
verses.english: O Master, appear to me! Now, appear to me! Nānyābhiḥ prārthanābhiḥ kadarthanāḥ te kurmaḥ, I will never ask any other thing as long as I am living. As long as I am in this world, I will ask nothing. I ask only that You should appear to me.

chapters.label: Chapter Seven
chapters.title: Conquering Helplessness

verses.iast: tvayy ānandasarasvati samarasatām etya nātha mama cetaḥ / pariharatu sakṛd iyantaṃ bhedādhīnaṃ mahānartham
verses.devanagari: त्वय्य् आनन्दसरस्वति समरसताम् एत्य नाथ मम चेतः / परिहरतु सकृद् इयन्तं भेदाधीनं महानर्थम्
verses.english: O my Master (nātha means “O my Master”), mama cetaḥ, I would like that my mind (mama cetaḥ), my mind would act like this.

verses.iast: etan mama na tv idam iti rāgadveṣādinigaḍadṛḍhamūle / nātha bhavanmayataikyapratyayaparaśuḥ patatvantaḥ
verses.devanagari: एतन् मम न त्व् इदम् इति रागद्वेषादिनिगडदृढमूले / नाथ भवन्मयतैक्यप्रत्ययपरशुः पतत्वन्तः
verses.english: And there is another problem in me, and that is, O my Master, “this is mine” (etan mama, this is mine), “I possess . . . this is my property” and “na tu idam, this is not mine”, “this is mine and this is not mine” . . .

verses.iast: galatu vikalpakalaṅkāvalī samullasatu hṛdi nirargalatā / bhagavann ānandarasaplutāstu me cinmayī mūrtiḥ
verses.devanagari: गलतु विकल्पकलङ्कावली समुल्लसतु हृदि निरर्गलता / भगवन्न् आनन्दरसप्लुतास्तु मे चिन्मयी मूर्तिः
