verses.english: Bhagavan, O Lord, let vikalpa kalaṅkāvalī galatu, let the kalaṅkāvalī (kalaṅkāvalī, the chain of this darkness, the darkness of differentiated perceptions, the chain of the darkness of differentiated perceptions), let the chain of the darkness of differentiated perceptions get destroyed altogether.

verses.iast: rāgādimayabhavāṇḍakaluṭhitaṃ tvadbhaktibhāvanāmbikā tais taiḥ / āpyāyayatu rasair māṃ pravṛddhapakṣo yathā bhavāmi khagaḥ
verses.devanagari: रागादिमयभवाण्डकलुठितं त्वद्भक्तिभावनाम्बिका तैस् तैः / आप्याययतु रसैर् मां प्रवृद्धपक्षो यथा भवामि खगः
verses.english: I am just like an egg, a bird egg.

verses.iast: tvaccaraṇabhāvanāmṛtarasasārāsvādanaipuṇaṃ labhatām / cittam idaṃ niḥśeṣitaviṣayaviṣāsaṅgavāsanāvadhi me
verses.devanagari: त्वच्चरणभावनामृतरससारास्वादनैपुणं लभताम् / चित्तम् इदं निःशेषितविषयविषासङ्गवासनावधि मे
verses.english: And there is another problem in me. That problem is, tvat caraṇa bhāvana amṛta rasasārāsvāda naipuṇaṁ. There is one thing to be done. That thing is–what is to be done in this world?–tvat caraṇa bhāvana amṛta, to taste the nectar of remembering Your lotus feet. This is to be done in this world. Just to taste the nectar of the remembrance of Your lotus feet; always taste the nectar of remembering Your lotus feet. But, the technique of tasting the nectar of Your lotus feet, the technique I don’t know, i.e., how to taste it. Let You teach me that technique! You teach me how to taste that nectar of [Your] lotus feet (naipuṇam means “the trick of that technique, the trick of understanding that technique”).

verses.iast: tvadbhaktitapanadīdhitisaṃsparśavaśān mamaiṣa dūrataram / cetomaṇir vimūñcaturāgādikataptavahnikaṇān
verses.devanagari: त्वद्भक्तितपनदीधितिसंस्पर्शवशान् ममैष दूरतरम् / चेतोमणिर् विमूञ्चतुरागादिकतप्तवह्निकणान्
verses.english: Actually, my mind is just like sūryakānta.

verses.iast: tasmin pade bhavantaṃ satatam upaślokayeyam atyuccaiḥ / hariharyaśvaviriñcā api yatra bahiḥ pratīkṣante
verses.devanagari: तस्मिन् पदे भवन्तं सततम् उपश्लोकयेयम् अत्युच्चैः / हरिहर्यश्वविरिञ्चा अपि यत्र बहिः प्रतीक्षन्ते
verses.english: I would like to reside at that point of divinity (tasmin pade bhavantam) and I would reside at that point of divinity and satatam upaśloka yeyaṁ atyuccaiḥ, and I would sing Your glory outside, outside That abode, the abode of God consciousness. Outside that abode of God consciousness, I will sing Your . . .

verses.iast: bhaktimadajanitavibhramavaśena paśyeyam avikalaṃ karaṇaiḥ / śivamayam akhilaṃ lokaṃ kriyāś ca pūjāmayī sakalāḥ
verses.devanagari: भक्तिमदजनितविभ्रमवशेन पश्येयम् अविकलं करणैः / शिवमयम् अखिलं लोकं क्रियाश् च पूजामयी सकलाः
verses.english: There is another problem and that problem is, I want madness. I want to get mad. I want to turn mad, absolutely mad! Mad for Thy devotion, bhaktimada (bhaktimada is madness for Your love). Bhaktimada janita vibhramavaśena, and, by that madness, I must feel absolutely different, from others (vibhramavaśena).

verses.iast: māmakamanogṛhītatvadbhaktikulāṅganāṇimādisutān / sūtvā subaddhamūlā mameti buddhiṃ dṛḍhīkurutām
verses.devanagari: मामकमनोगृहीतत्वद्भक्तिकुलाङ्गनाणिमादिसुतान् / सूत्वा सुबद्धमूला ममेति बुद्धिं दृढीकुरुताम्
verses.english: My mind is a boy, a young boy. My mind is just like a young boy in his perfect youth and he has–my mind, that boy–has gṛhīta, possessed tvad bhakti kulāṅganā, a wife, and that is Your devotion. Your devotion is a beautiful girl. [My mind] has possessed that beautiful girl.

chapters.label: Chapter Eight
chapters.title: Supernatural Power

verses.iast: yaḥ prasādalava īśvarasthito yā ca bhaktir iva mām upeyuṣī / tau parasparasamanvitau kadā tādṛśe vapuṣi rūḍhim eṣyataḥ
verses.devanagari: यः प्रसादलव ईश्वरस्थितो या च भक्तिर् इव माम् उपेयुषी / तौ परस्परसमन्वितौ कदा तादृशे वपुषि रूढिम् एष्यतः
verses.english: O Lord, yaḥ prasādalava īśvaraḥ sthitaḥ, one thing is just these lava.

verses.iast: tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā ko 'py udetu paritoṣaraso 'ntaḥ / sarvakālam iha me param astu jñānayogamahimādi vidūre
verses.devanagari: त्वत्प्रभुत्वपरिचर्वणजन्मा को ऽप्य् उदेतु परितोषरसो ऽन्तः / सर्वकालम् इह मे परम् अस्तु ज्ञानयोगमहिमादि विदूरे
verses.english: Tvat prabhutva paricarvaṇa janmā ko’pi udetu paritoṣa raso antaḥ sarvakāla. Always let that kind of paritoṣa rasaḥ, that kind of the rasa (the taste of satisfaction, real satisfaction), let the taste of that real satisfaction rise always in me; that real satisfaction when I will be really satisfied, when I will be really full, I will get myself filled with that satisfaction.

verses.iast: lokavadbhavatu me viṣayeṣu sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ / kevalaṃ tava śarīratayaitān+ lokayeyam aham astavikalpaḥ
verses.devanagari: लोकवद्भवतु मे विषयेषु स्फीत एव भगवन्परितर्षः / केवलं तव शरीरतयैतान्+ लोकयेयम् अहम् अस्तविकल्पः
verses.english: Bhagavan, O Lord, I don’t want that these hankerings after worldly pleasures should be discarded in me. Let this state of hankering after worldly objects remain in me. I don’t want that they should vanish altogether.

verses.iast: dehabhūmiṣu tathā manasi tvaṃ prāṇavartmani ca bhedam upete / saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca tena svātmanā mama bhava sphuṭarūpaḥ
verses.devanagari: देहभूमिषु तथा मनसि त्वं प्राणवर्त्मनि च भेदम् उपेते / संविदः पथिषु तेषु च तेन स्वात्मना मम भव स्फुटरूपः
verses.english: O Lord, there are four sections of states. One section is the section of deha pramātṛ bhāva, when you are residing in wakefulness (jāgrat). Another section is when you are residing in the world of thought, that is svapna (the dreaming state). Another is the world of prāṇa, when you are residing in dreamless sleep.

verses.iast: nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā mama / kṣaṇamapīśa manāg api maiva bhūt tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam
verses.devanagari: निजनिजेषु पदेषु पतन्त्व् इमाः करणवृत्तय उल्लसिता मम / क्षणमपीश मनाग् अपि मैव भूत् त्वदविभेदरसक्षतिसाहसम्
verses.english: O Lord, let my organs work in their own senses. I don’t want to withdraw them from sensual pleasures. Let them work on their sensual objects.

verses.iast: laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ bhavadāveśavaśena bhāvayan / vapur akhilapadārthapaddhater vyavahārān ativartayeya tān
verses.devanagari: लघुमसृणसिताच्छशीतलं भवदावेशवशेन भावयन् / वपुर् अखिलपदार्थपद्धतेर् व्यवहारान् अतिवर्तयेय तान्
verses.english: Akhila padārtha paddhateḥ vapur bhāvayan. I must perceive all of the formations of all of the objective world in this way: laghu (very light), masṛṇa (very soft), sita (absolutely white, without any dots), acha (very pure), śītalaṁ (cooling).

verses.iast: vikasatu svavapur bhavadātmakaṃ samupayāntu jaganti mamāṅgatām / vrajatu sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ smṛtipathopagame 'py anupākhyatām
verses.devanagari: विकसतु स्ववपुर् भवदात्मकं समुपयान्तु जगन्ति ममाङ्गताम् / व्रजतु सर्वम् इदं द्वयवल्गितं स्मृतिपथोपगमे ऽप्य् अनुपाख्यताम्
verses.english: Let my individuality shine in the svarūpa of Your universality. Let my individual consciousness shine in the svarūpa123 of Your universal consciousness.

verses.iast: samudiyād api tādṛśatāvakānana viloka parāmṛtasamplavaḥ / mama ghaṭeta yathā bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam
verses.devanagari: समुदियाद् अपि तादृशतावकानन विलोक परामृतसम्प्लवः / मम घटेत यथा भवदद्वयाप्रथनघोरदरीपरिपूरणम्
verses.english: Tādṛśa tāvaka ānana viloka parāmṛta samplavaḥ. Let that great flood occur on me. Let me be flooded with that great flood.

verses.iast: api kadācana tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā / sakalalokasukheṣu parāṅmukho na bhavitāsmy ubhayacyuta eva kim
verses.devanagari: अपि कदाचन तावकसङ्गमामृतकणाच्छुरणेन तनीयसा / सकललोकसुखेषु पराङ्मुखो न भवितास्म्य् उभयच्युत एव किम्
verses.english: O Lord, the nearness of Thy consciousness, of that nectar, divine nectar, takes place in my mind very seldom, not always, not each day. Tāvakasaṅgama amṛta kaṇa ācchuraṇena, the soaking or being sprinkled by the divine nectar of Your nearness of Your consciousness, it is tanīyasā, and that sprinkling is also a very minute sprinkling.

verses.iast: satatam eva bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya hi haṃsavarasya me / upari mūlatalād api cāntarād upanamatv aja bhaktimṛṇālikā
verses.devanagari: सततम् एव भवच्चरणाम्बुजाकरचरस्य हि हंसवरस्य मे / उपरि मूलतलाद् अपि चान्तराद् उपनमत्व् अज भक्तिमृणालिका
verses.english: In fact, I am just like that swan. I am haṁsavara (haṁsavara means “just like a swan”).

verses.iast: upayāntu vibho samastavastūny api cintāviṣayaṃ dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca / mama darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi paraṃ parisphurantu
verses.devanagari: उपयान्तु विभो समस्तवस्तून्य् अपि चिन्ताविषयं दृशः पदं च / मम दर्शनचिन्तनप्रकाशामृतसाराणि परं परिस्फुरन्तु
verses.english: Vibho, O my Master, I don’t want to discard this objective world or the impressions and thoughts and desires for this objective world, or not to perceive this objective world. Let it be perceived. Let thoughts come regarding the same. Let this objective world remain present for twenty-four hours [a day] before me. I don’t want to discard it.

verses.iast: parameśvara teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api nāmopanamatsv ahaṃ bhaveyam / na paraṃ gatabhīs tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado 'pi yāvat
verses.devanagari: परमेश्वर तेषु तेषु कृच्छ्रेष्व् अपि नामोपनमत्स्व् अहं भवेयम् / न परं गतभीस् त्वदङ्गसङ्गादुपजाताधिकसम्मदो ऽपि यावत्
verses.english: O Lord Śiva, teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣu api nāma upanamatsu, let all those crises fall only on me. Crises of the world, depressions of the world, ruins of the world, disastrous things of the world, let those fall on me. I welcome them. But, tvad aṅga saṅga, I must be embraced with You. My body must be embraced with You.

verses.iast: bhavadātmani viśvam umbhitaṃ yad bhavataivāpi bahiḥ prakāśyate tat / iti yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām
verses.devanagari: भवदात्मनि विश्वम् उम्भितं यद् भवतैवापि बहिः प्रकाश्यते तत् / इति यद् दृढनिश्चयोपजुष्टं तद् इदानिं स्फुटम् एव भासताम्
verses.english: From the philosophical point of view, I have understood that this whole universe is one with Thee. Bhavad ātmani viśvam umbhitam, this whole universe is woven in Your consciousness. That is a fact to me. And I read this in all of these spiritual books that this universe is woven in Your consciousness. And, at the same time, bahiḥ prakāśyate, one feels like that. One feels the universe . . . that person who is fully aware, he feels that, he feels that way of the universe. But this I have concluded [intellectually]; this is my conclusion in [intellectual] understanding. But this is only [intellectual] understanding that I have understood this way of the existence of the universe. I want to experience it! Let me experience it. Give me the capacity to experience this in a practical way. That is all. Tadidānīm sphuṭameva bhāsatām, let me experience this way of the actual position of the universe.

chapters.label: Chapter Nine
chapters.title: The Victory of Absolute Freedom

verses.iast: kadā navarasārdrārdrasambhogāsvādanotsukam / pravarteta vihāyānyan mama tvatsparśane manaḥ
verses.devanagari: कदा नवरसार्द्रार्द्रसम्भोगास्वादनोत्सुकम् / प्रवर्तेत विहायान्यन् मम त्वत्स्पर्शने मनः
verses.english: O Lord, when that time will come before me when navasārdrārdra sambhoga āsvādana utsukam, when mama manaḥ (my mind), which is navasārdrārdra sambhoga āsvādana utsukam . . . it is already like that. My mind is already like that. [My mind] is fond of navarasa ārdrārdra sambhoga, just to enjoy the taste of the always new taste of the nectar of the Lord’s devotion. [My mind] has got fondness of tasting the nectar of the nearness of God consciousness.

verses.iast: tvadekaraktas tvatpādapūjāmātramahādhanaḥ / kadā sākṣātkariṣyāmi bhavantam ayam utsukaḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वदेकरक्तस् त्वत्पादपूजामात्रमहाधनः / कदा साक्षात्करिष्यामि भवन्तम् अयम् उत्सुकः
verses.english: Tvadekaraktaḥ. I am utsukaḥ, I am utsukaḥ. This, myself, I am utsukaḥ. “I am” means I am (aham) utsukaḥ, who is utsukaḥ, who is fond of, or who is yearning.

verses.iast: gāḍhānurāgavaśato nirapekṣībhūtamānaso 'smi kadā / paṭapaṭiti vighaṭitākhilamahārgalas tvām upaiṣyāmi
verses.devanagari: गाढानुरागवशतो निरपेक्षीभूतमानसो ऽस्मि कदा / पटपटिति विघटिताखिलमहार्गलस् त्वाम् उपैष्यामि
verses.english: When that day will come to me?

verses.iast: svasaṃvitsārahṛdayādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ / kadā nātha vaśīkuryāṃ bhavadbhaktiprabhāvataḥ
verses.devanagari: स्वसंवित्सारहृदयाधिष्ठानाः सर्वदेवताः / कदा नाथ वशीकुर्यां भवद्भक्तिप्रभावतः
verses.english: All of my devatās, sva saṁvit sāra hṛdaya adhiṣṭānāḥ sarvadevatāḥ, all of these deities, all these deities [which are] organic134 deities–my eyes, my ears, my nose, my throat, my tongue, my body, my skin–actually, sva saṁvit sara hṛdaya adhiṣṭhānāḥ, they are residing in one’s own consciousness. Sva saṁvit sāra hṛdaya adhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvadevatā, all of this organic section, organic class of organs, all of these organs, are actually sva saṁvit sāra hṛdaya adhiṣṭhānā, they are residing on the basis of God consciousness. They are residing on the basis of God consciousness.135

verses.iast: kadā me syād vibho bhūri bhaktyānandarasotsavaḥ / yadālokasukhānandī pṛthaṅ nāmāpi lapsyate
verses.devanagari: कदा मे स्याद् विभो भूरि भक्त्यानन्दरसोत्सवः / यदालोकसुखानन्दी पृथङ् नामापि लप्स्यते
verses.english: Vibho, O Lord, when that day will come to me when I will possess bhūri bhaktyānanda rasotsavaḥ, I will possess the intensity, the utsavaḥ, the intense festival of Your devotion?

verses.iast: īśvaram abhayam udāraṃ pūrṇam akāraṇam apahnutātmānaṃ / sahasābhijñāya kadā svāmijanaṃ lajjayiṣyāmi
verses.devanagari: ईश्वरम् अभयम् उदारं पूर्णम् अकारणम् अपह्नुतात्मानं / सहसाभिज्ञाय कदा स्वामिजनं लज्जयिष्यामि
verses.english: Actually, Lord Śiva, You who are Lord Śiva, You are abhaya, You have no fear, You are fearless. Udāram, You are extravagant, You spend in Your own way. You don’t ask anybody’s decision, e.g., “should I spend this much or that much?” Īśvaram abhayam udāram, fearlessness is with You and udāram, this extravagance, the qualification of being extravagant . . . extravagance is in You. Pūrṇam, and still You are pūrṇa, You are filled always, i.e., there is nothing lacking [in You]. Akāraṇam, and You have no father and mother. You are absolutely . . . absolutely, You have come from incorrect sex.139 It is why You have possessed so many disqualifications. You are “disqualified” because You have [no] fear, You don’t fear anybody, and udāram, You are extravagant. This is also a disqualification.140 Pūrṇam, and this is a misfortune for me that You are always full.

verses.iast: kadā kām api tāṃ nātha tava vallabhatām iyām / yayā māṃ prati na kvāpi yuktaṃ te syāt palāyitum
verses.devanagari: कदा काम् अपि तां नाथ तव वल्लभताम् इयाम् / यया मां प्रति न क्वापि युक्तं ते स्यात् पलायितुम्
verses.english: Alright, leave everything aside! Don’t come to me! But only there is one request. I want to ask You, I want to own that intensity of love for You, intense love, extremity of love for Thee. When that state of extremity of love for Thee will rise in me? When that day will come when there will be [such] extreme love for Thee, by which extremity of love (yayā, by which), māṁ prati na kvāpi yuktaṁ, there will be no way for You to hide from me? There will remain no excuse for You to hide from me because of my intensity of love. My intensity of love will make You always remain in front of me. When that day will come?

verses.iast: tattvato 'śeṣajantūnāṃ bhavatpūjāmayātmanām / dṛṣṭyānumoditarasāplāvitaḥ syāṃ kadā vibho
verses.devanagari: तत्त्वतो ऽशेषजन्तूनां भवत्पूजामयात्मनाम् / दृष्ट्यानुमोदितरसाप्लावितः स्यां कदा विभो
verses.english: Vibho, O Lord, in fact (tattvato means “in fact”), aśeṣajantunāṁ bhavat pūjā mayātmanām, everybody, each and everybody, not knowingly or knowingly, worships You. Everybody worships You!

verses.iast: jñānasya paramā bhūmir yogasya paramā daśā / tvadbhaktir yā vibho karhi pūrṇa me syāt tadarthitā
verses.devanagari: ज्ञानस्य परमा भूमिर् योगस्य परमा दशा / त्वद्भक्तिर् या विभो कर्हि पूर्ण मे स्यात् तदर्थिता
verses.english: Vibho, O Lord, O pervading, all-pervading Lord, really Your devotion, this is Your devotion that is the supreme state of knowledge and that is the supreme state of yoga. The supreme state of yoga and the supreme state of knowledge is just Your devotion, that is all. Just Your love.143

verses.iast: sahasaivasādya kadā gāḍham avaṣṭabhya harṣavivaśo 'ham / tvaccaraṇavaranidhānaṃ sarvasya prakaṭayiṣyāmi
verses.devanagari: सहसैवसाद्य कदा गाढम् अवष्टभ्य हर्षविवशो ऽहम् / त्वच्चरणवरनिधानं सर्वस्य प्रकटयिष्यामि
verses.english: Now, there is another problem. That is, tvat caraṇa vara nidhānam, the treasure of Your divine feet (that is that supreme state treasure) . . .

verses.iast: paritaḥ prasaracchuddhatvadālokamayaḥ kadā / syāṃ yatheśa na kiñcin me māyācchāyābilaṃ bhavet
verses.devanagari: परितः प्रसरच्छुद्धत्वदालोकमयः कदा / स्यां यथेश न किञ्चिन् मे मायाच्छायाबिलं भवेत्
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, when that day will come when paritaḥ prasarat śuddha tvad ālokamayaḥ syāṁ, Your light will be so flooded in me that I would become one with That light, one with that light of Thy consciousness, by which light, na kiñcit me māyāt chāyā bilaṁ bhavet, there will be no traces of any darkness of illusion? No traces of the darkness of illusion will remain there. When that day will come to me?

verses.iast: ātmasātkṛtaniḥśeṣamaṇḍalo nirvyapekṣakaḥ / kadā bhaveyaṃ bhagavaṃs tvadbhaktagaṇanāyakaḥ
verses.devanagari: आत्मसात्कृतनिःशेषमण्डलो निर्व्यपेक्षकः / कदा भवेयं भगवंस् त्वद्भक्तगणनायकः
verses.english: O Lord, O Bhagavan, O Lord, ātmasāt kṛta niḥśeṣa maṇḍalaḥ, I would like to achieve that state when I will be united with this whole universal consciousness, universe, all of the universe. This universal consciousness will be united with me; I will be united with universal consciousness.

verses.iast: nātha lokābhimānānām apūrvaṃ tvaṃ nibandhanam / mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṃ tvadbhaktirasapūritaḥ
verses.devanagari: नाथ लोकाभिमानानाम् अपूर्वं त्वं निबन्धनम् / महाभिमानः कर्हि स्यां त्वद्भक्तिरसपूरितः
verses.english: This I-ness, this ego, [which] is found in this universe, the sensation of ego comes from You. In fact, this sensation of ego, which is found in each and every individual, it has flown out from You. It is You who has produced this ego in each and every being. But I don’t want that ego. That kind of ego, I don’t want. Mahābhimānaḥ karhi syāṁ, I would like that universal I-consciousness, the ego of universal I-consciousness. When that day will come when I will achieve that ego of universal I-consciousness and when I will be bhakti rasa pūritaḥ, I will be soaked in the rasa of Your devotion?

verses.iast: aśeṣaviṣayāśūnyaśrīsamāśleṣasusthitaḥ / śayīyam iva śītāṅghrikuśeśayayuge kadā
verses.devanagari: अशेषविषयाशून्यश्रीसमाश्लेषसुस्थितः / शयीयम् इव शीताङ्घ्रिकुशेशययुगे कदा
verses.english: There is one problem in me, in my life. Aśeṣa viṣaya aśūnya śrī samāśleṣasusthitaḥ, śītāṅghri kuśeśayayuge, Your two feet, which are very cooling, aṅghri, and these feet are just like lotuses, two lotuses, I would like to sleep on them. When that day will come when I will sleep on those two lotuses, already having embraced the woman of liberation, the woman who is the embodiment of liberation? Because, when I will embrace [her], when I will lie down on those lotus feet of Yours, I will be liberated. So, that liberation–liberation he has [described] as a beautiful girl–and that liberation, that Lakṣmī (the goddess of spiritual wealth), I would embrace on that bed.

verses.iast: bhaktyāsavasamṛddhāyās tvatpūjābhogasampadaḥ / kadā pāraṃ gamiṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi kadā kṛtī
verses.devanagari: भक्त्यासवसमृद्धायास् त्वत्पूजाभोगसम्पदः / कदा पारं गमिष्यामि भविष्यामि कदा कृती
verses.english: Bhaktyāsava smṛddhāyāḥ tvat pūjā bhoga sampadaḥ. Thy devotion, Thy worship, this is the great wealth, this is the great treasure, this is really the great treasure. Enjoyment of that treasure is enjoying that treasure.

verses.iast: ānandabāṣpapūraskhalitaparibhrāntagadgadākrandaḥ / hāsollāsitavadanas tvatsparśarasaṃ kadāpsyāmi
verses.devanagari: आनन्दबाष्पपूरस्खलितपरिभ्रान्तगद्गदाक्रन्दः / हासोल्लासितवदनस् त्वत्स्पर्शरसं कदाप्स्यामि
verses.english: When that rasa of Thy sparśa, Thy embrace, will shine in me? When shall I enjoy this fragrance, Thy sweetness of Your embrace (tvat sparśa rasaṁ)? Kadāpsyāmi, when shall I achieve that?

verses.iast: paśujanasamānavṛttām avadhūya daśām imāṃ kadā śambho / āsvādayeya tāvakabhaktocitam ātmano rūpam
verses.devanagari: पशुजनसमानवृत्ताम् अवधूय दशाम् इमां कदा शम्भो / आस्वादयेय तावकभक्तोचितम् आत्मनो रूपम्
verses.english: Śambho, O Lord Śiva, really it is disgraceful! Not only for me, it is also for You disgraceful. It is disgraceful [because] You know I am Your devotee and still, paśujana samāna vṛttām daśām, I am just like others, just like ignorant persons, roaming from door to door like an ordinary worldly person.

verses.iast: labdhāṇimādisiddhir vigalitasakalopatāpasantrāsaḥ / tvadbhaktirasāyanapānakriḍhāniṣṭaḥ kadāsīya
verses.devanagari: लब्धाणिमादिसिद्धिर् विगलितसकलोपतापसन्त्रासः / त्वद्भक्तिरसायनपानक्रिढानिष्टः कदासीय
verses.english: When that day will come, my Lord, when I would have possessed, achieved, all of those eight yogic powers, vigalita sakala upatāpa santrāsaḥ, and I will be . . . all upatāpa (all torture) and trāsaḥ (fear), all dread and torture would be vanished, would get vanished, tvad bhakti rasāyana pāna krīḍāniṣṭhaḥ, and I would play, I would be playful, joyful, in drinking the nectar of Your devotion? Kadāsīya, when this state will come to me?

verses.iast: nātha kadā sa tathāvidha ākrando me samuccared vāci / yat samanantaram eva sphurati puras tāvakī mūrtiḥ
verses.devanagari: नाथ कदा स तथाविध आक्रन्दो मे समुच्चरेद् वाचि / यत् समनन्तरम् एव स्फुरति पुरस् तावकी मूर्तिः
verses.english: O my dear nātha, O my dear [Lord], when that day will come when I will cry, only in one word, “O my Lord! O my Lord”, in such a way . . . when that day will come that I will produce this one cry, one cry only, one cry, in such a way that You will have no excuse to ignore me at all, and You will just appear before me at that very moment when I cry? At the next moment, You will appear, Your mūrti, Your beautiful shape and beautiful body, will appear to me, in front of me, by that one cry. When that such cry I will utter? When that day will come when I will utter such a cry, only one cry, by which cry, samantarameva sphurati puraḥ, You will have no excuse to hide?

verses.iast: gāḍhagāḍhabhavadaṅghrisarojāliṅganavyasanatatparacetāḥ / vastv avastv idam ayatnata eva tvāṃ kadā samavalokayitāsmi
verses.devanagari: गाढगाढभवदङ्घ्रिसरोजालिङ्गनव्यसनतत्परचेताः / वस्त्व् अवस्त्व् इदम् अयत्नत एव त्वां कदा समवलोकयितास्मि
verses.english: There is one desire in me, my Lord. Gāḍha gāḍha bhavat aṅghri saroja āliṅgana vyasana tatparacetāḥ, I would like to be, to take this state of my position, that gāḍha gāḍha bhavat aṅghri saroja, Thy lotus feet, I would gāḍha gāḍha āliṅgana, . . .

chapters.label: Chapter Ten
chapters.title: The Continuity of God Consciousness is Broken Avicchedabhaṅgākhyaṁ daśamaṁ stotram

verses.iast: na soḍhavyam avaśyam te jagadekaprabhor idam / māheśvarāś ca lokānām itareṣāṃ samāś ca yat
verses.devanagari: न सोढव्यम् अवश्यम् ते जगदेकप्रभोर् इदम् / माहेश्वराश् च लोकानाम् इतरेषां समाश् च यत्
verses.english: Jagadeka prabhor. O, the only Lord of the universe, the only Lord of the universe–You are the only Lord of this universe–how do You tolerate this, that Your slaves (Your devotees) and other worldly people reside on the same level? It should not happen that Your devotees tread on the same path and they remain on the same level where ordinary worldly people are. How do You tolerate this? You should not tolerate this.

verses.iast: ye sadaivānurāgeṇa bhavatpādānugāminaḥ / yatra tatra gatā bhogāṃs te kāṃś cid upabhuñjate
verses.devanagari: ये सदैवानुरागेण भवत्पादानुगामिनः / यत्र तत्र गता भोगांस् ते कांश् चिद् उपभुञ्जते
verses.english: Lord, those people who are always following the pathway on which Your lotus feet travel–they are following that pathway–and those people who are following that pathway with great love and affection, yatra tatra gatāḥ, never mind if they are situated in any [particular] position, in any worldly state, te kāṁcit bhogān upa-bhuñjate, they enjoy some supreme camatkāra, supreme taste, supreme spiritual taste. So, they don’t worry about that.146

verses.iast: bhartā kālāntako yatra bhavāṃs tatra kuto rujaḥ / tatra cetarabhogāśā kā lakṣmīr yatra tāvakī
verses.devanagari: भर्ता कालान्तको यत्र भवांस् तत्र कुतो रुजः / तत्र चेतरभोगाशा का लक्ष्मीर् यत्र तावकी
verses.english: Where kālāntakaḥ, the destroyer of the lord of death . . .

verses.iast: kṣanamātrasukhenāpi vibhur yenāsi labhyase / tadaiva sarvaḥ kālo 'sya tvadānandena pūryate
verses.devanagari: क्षनमात्रसुखेनापि विभुर् येनासि लभ्यसे / तदैव सर्वः कालो ऽस्य त्वदानन्देन पूर्यते
verses.english: Kṣaṇamātra sukhenāpi vibhur yenāsi labhyase. When Thou, Lord, is achieved by some person, though in just a flash of super-sexual joy, only a flash of super-sexual joy (it means only for half a second), that flash of joy, super-sexual joy,147 rises only for kṣaṇa . . .

verses.iast: ānandarasabindus te candramā galito bhuvi / sūryas tathā te prasṛtaḥ saṃhārī tejasaḥ kaṇaḥ
verses.devanagari: आनन्दरसबिन्दुस् ते चन्द्रमा गलितो भुवि / सूर्यस् तथा ते प्रसृतः संहारी तेजसः कणः
verses.english: You see this moon that shines in the sky, that is only one drop of the nectar of Your spiritual bliss. It is only one drop, which shines . . . the shining of the moon. You find this moon so pleasing and so soothing to everybody, and this is only one drop of that super-sexual joy, [which] has entered in that substance [of the] moon.

verses.iast: baliṃ yāmas tṛtīyāya netrāyāsmai tava prabho / alaukikasya kasyāpi māhātmyasyaikalakṣmaṇe
verses.devanagari: बलिं यामस् तृतीयाय नेत्रायास्मै तव प्रभो / अलौकिकस्य कस्यापि माहात्म्यस्यैकलक्ष्मणे
verses.english: You see this moon that shines in the sky, that is only one drop of the nectar of Your spiritual bliss. It is only one drop, which shines . . . the shining of the moon. You find this moon so pleasing and so soothing to everybody, and this is only one drop of that super-sexual joy, [which] has entered in that substance [of the] moon.

verses.iast: tenaiva dṛṣṭo 'si bhavaddarśanādyo 'tihṛṣyati / kathañcid yasya vā harṣaḥ ko 'pi tena tvam īkṣitaḥ
verses.devanagari: तेनैव दृष्टो ऽसि भवद्दर्शनाद्यो ऽतिहृष्यति / कथञ्चिद् यस्य वा हर्षः को ऽपि तेन त्वम् ईक्षितः
verses.english: In the real sense, he has actually perceived and seen You who, by seeing You, will become atihṛṣyati (atihṛṣyati means “his joy will find no bounds”). He will be out of bounds in joy.

verses.iast: yeṣām prasanno 'si vibho yair labdhaṃ hṛdayaṃ tava / ākṛṣya tvatpurāttais tu bāhyam ābhyantarīkṛtam
verses.devanagari: येषाम् प्रसन्नो ऽसि विभो यैर् लब्धं हृदयं तव / आकृष्य त्वत्पुरात्तैस् तु बाह्यम् आभ्यन्तरीकृतम्
verses.english: Vibho150, O Lord, to whom You are actually pleased, with whom You are pleased, yairlabdhaṁ hṛdayaṁ tava, and those who have achieved and perceived Your heart, Your internal heart, those persons only have done this thing.

verses.iast: tvad ṛte nikhilaṃ viśvaṃ samadṛgyātam īkṣyatām / īśvaraḥ punar etasya tvam eko viṣamekṣaṇaḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वद् ऋते निखिलं विश्वं समदृग्यातम् ईक्ष्यताम् / ईश्वरः पुनर् एतस्य त्वम् एको विषमेक्षणः
verses.english: [Except for] Thee, this whole universe, everybody sees, observes this universe, with two eyes in a dualistic way, [except for] You. [Except for] You, everybody perceives this universe in a dualistic way, with two eyes. But only You are that person who perceives this [universe] with one eye, only the third eye, in a monistic way. This is the difference (viṣamekṣaṇaḥ).151

verses.iast: āstāṃ bhavatprabhāveṇa vinā sattaiva nāsti yat / tvaddūṣaṇakathā yeṣām tvad ṛte nopapadyate
verses.devanagari: आस्तां भवत्प्रभावेण विना सत्तैव नास्ति यत् / त्वद्दूषणकथा येषाम् त्वद् ऋते नोपपद्यते
verses.english: Bhavat prabhāveṇa vinā sattaiva nāsti yat. This is a fact that without Thy glory, without the existence, appearance, of Your glory, nothing can exist in this universe. This is a real fact that without Your glory, nothing can exist. There must be Your glory for existence. If this [microphone] exists, it exists only because of Your glory. Your glory is there, so it exists.

verses.iast: bāhyāntarāntarāyālīkevale cetasi sthitiḥ / tvayi cet syān mama vibho kim anyad upayujyate
verses.devanagari: बाह्यान्तरान्तरायालीकेवले चेतसि स्थितिः / त्वयि चेत् स्यान् मम विभो किम् अन्यद् उपयुज्यते
verses.english: O Lord, vibho, O Lord, if my mind is established in Thy Self, if my mind is established, becomes established, in Thy Self, and my mind will take the position of being detached from outward universality (the outward universe), the introverted universe, and the void universe, then the outward universe, the introverted universe, and the void universe will not exist in my mind.153 My mind will be absolutely away from these three sections of universes. Arthāt154, the outward universe won’t exist in my mind, the introverted universe won’t exist in my mind, and the void universe won’t exist in my mind. And, in that mind, if You prevail, Your existence shines, establishes [Itself], kimanyadupayujyate, what do I need then? I need nothing then! My needs are complete, altogether.

verses.iast: anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātiduḥsthitāḥ / anye bhramanti bhagavann ātmany evātisusthitāḥ
verses.devanagari: अन्ये भ्रमन्ति भगवन्न् आत्मन्य् एवातिदुःस्थिताः / अन्ये भ्रमन्ति भगवन्न् आत्मन्य् एवातिसुस्थिताः
verses.english: O Lord, some people . . .

verses.iast: apītvāpi bhavadbhaktisudhām anavalokya ca / tvām īśa tvatsamācāramātrāt siddhyanti jantavaḥ
verses.devanagari: अपीत्वापि भवद्भक्तिसुधाम् अनवलोक्य च / त्वाम् ईश त्वत्समाचारमात्रात् सिद्ध्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.english: O Lord, bhavad bhakti sudhām apītvāpi, those who have not tasted the nectar of Your devotion, who have not tasted the nectar of Your devotion and anavalokya ca tvām, who have not experienced the state of Your God consciousness–those people who have not experienced the state of God consciousness and those people who have not tasted the nectar of Your devotion–but still, tvat samācāramātrā, by hearing Your name from the outside world also, they get entry in God consciousness! There are such people who, without getting entry in God consciousness and without adoption of devotion for Thee–they have not tasted the nectar of Your devotion and they have not entered in the state of God consciousness–but still, they are so fine and they are so close to You that by hearing Your one name from outside, from some[one’s] lips, they get entry. They are so great!

verses.iast: bhṛtyā vayaṃ tava vibho tena trijagatāṃ yathā / bibharṣy ātmānam evaṃ te bharttavyā vayam apy alam
verses.devanagari: भृत्या वयं तव विभो तेन त्रिजगतां यथा / बिभर्ष्य् आत्मानम् एवं ते भर्त्तव्या वयम् अप्य् अलम्
verses.english: O Lord, we are Your slaves. There is no doubt that we are slaves. Tena, so, trijagatāṁ yathā bibharṣi . . .

verses.iast: parānandāmṛtamaye dṛṣṭo 'pi jagadātmani / tvayi sparśarase 'tyantatarasutkaṇṭhito(?) 'smi te
verses.devanagari: परानन्दामृतमये दृष्टो ऽपि जगदात्मनि / त्वयि स्पर्शरसे ऽत्यन्ततरसुत्कण्ठितो(?) ऽस्मि ते
verses.english: Although, O Lord, I have seen You and I have experienced the state of Your being, which is filled with the supreme nectar of bliss, but still there is some need in my mind just to embrace You. I want to just embrace You. And this is always tickling in the background of my desire (icchā śakti) that I want to embrace You.

verses.iast: deva duḥkhāny aśeṣāṇi yāni saṃsāriṇām api / ghṛtyākhyabhavadīyātmayutāny āyānti sahyatām
verses.devanagari: देव दुःखान्य् अशेषाणि यानि संसारिणाम् अपि / घृत्याख्यभवदीयात्मयुतान्य् आयान्ति सह्यताम्
verses.english: O Lord, saṁsāriṇām api yāni aśeṣāni duḥkhāni, those tortures and those pains, sorrows, sadnesses, in this universe, what[ever tortures] come here, and they are tolerated by everybody. [They] are tolerated only . . . the cause of this tolerance is just Your nearness. You are near to them, so they tolerate it. Otherwise, nobody would tolerate any sadness, any torture, in this universe. It is tolerated only because of Thy presence. You are present and so it is tolerated.

verses.iast: sarvajñe sarvaśaktau ca tvayy eva sati cinmaye / sarvathāpy asato nātha yuktāsya jagataḥ prathā
verses.devanagari: सर्वज्ञे सर्वशक्तौ च त्वय्य् एव सति चिन्मये / सर्वथाप्य् असतो नाथ युक्तास्य जगतः प्रथा
verses.english: The existence of the universe, in fact, is sarvathā api asataḥ, it is not existing. This existence of the universe is false, it is unreal, it should not exist!

verses.iast: tvatprāṇitāḥ sphurantīme guṇā loṣṭopamā api / nṛtyanti pavanoddhūtāḥ kārpāsāḥ picavo yathā
verses.devanagari: त्वत्प्राणिताः स्फुरन्तीमे गुणा लोष्टोपमा अपि / नृत्यन्ति पवनोद्धूताः कार्पासाः पिचवो यथा
verses.english: O Lord, ime guṇā, these senses (senses of action and senses of cognition), these five senses of action and five senses of cognition, they are actually loṣṭopamā api, just like a rock. They have no life. All of these ten senses have no life. They are just like loṣṭa (loṣṭa means this “ball of earth”), just a dead ball of earth. But, tvatprāṇita, when You inject Your consciousness in them, sphuranti, they do their acting.

verses.iast: yadi nātha guṇeṣv ātmābhimāno na bhavet tataḥ / kena hīyeta jagatas tvadekātmatayā prathā
verses.devanagari: यदि नाथ गुणेष्व् आत्माभिमानो न भवेत् ततः / केन हीयेत जगतस् त्वदेकात्मतया प्रथा
verses.english: O Lord, ime guṇā, these senses (senses of action and senses of cognition), these five senses of action and five senses of cognition, they are actually loṣṭopamā api, just like a rock. They have no life. All of these ten senses have no life. They are just like loṣṭa (loṣṭa means this “ball of earth”), just a dead ball of earth. But, tvatprāṇita, when You inject Your consciousness in them, sphuranti, they do their acting.

verses.iast: vandyās te 'pi mahīyāṃsaḥ pralayopagatā api / tvatkopapāvakasparśapūtā ye parameśvara
verses.devanagari: वन्द्यास् ते ऽपि महीयांसः प्रलयोपगता अपि / त्वत्कोपपावकस्पर्शपूता ये परमेश्वर
verses.english: O parameśvaraḥ, O Lord, pralayopayatā api tvat kopa pāvaka sparśapūtā, those who have been killed by You with wrath . . .

verses.iast: mahāprakāśavapuṣi vispaṣṭe bhavati sthite / sarvato 'pīśa tat kasmāt tamasi prasarāmy aham
verses.devanagari: महाप्रकाशवपुषि विस्पष्टे भवति स्थिते / सर्वतो ऽपीश तत् कस्मात् तमसि प्रसराम्य् अहम्
verses.english: It is a fact that Your existence is everywhere found, mahāprakāśa vapuṣi, because it is all-light, all-consciousness, everywhere. Your existence is found everywhere. But, although it is found by me also everywhere, why do I roam in darkness every now and then? What is the cause of that, that I am existing in only darkness, dense darkness?

verses.iast: avibhāgo bhavān eva svarūpam amṛtaṃ mama / tathāpi martyadharmāṇām aham evaikam āspadam
verses.devanagari: अविभागो भवान् एव स्वरूपम् अमृतं मम / तथापि मर्त्यधर्माणाम् अहम् एवैकम् आस्पदम्
verses.english: Actually, You are universal, You are everywhere, and my body is one with Your body. My body is one with Your ‘nectared’ body. But still, it is a wonder for me why I am given to all aspects, which are mortal aspects, e.g., I have got headache, I have got nasal trouble, I have got boils, I have got everything, I have got all sadnesses. All sadnesses, all sorrows come to me. This is a wonder.

verses.iast: maheśvareti yasyāsti nāmakaṃ vāgvibhūṣaṇam / praṇāmāṅkaś ca śirasi sa evaikaḥ prabhāvitaḥ
verses.devanagari: महेश्वरेति यस्यास्ति नामकं वाग्विभूषणम् / प्रणामाङ्कश् च शिरसि स एवैकः प्रभावितः
verses.english: That person whose tongue is glorified with Thy name, whose tongue always recites Your name, maheśvara iti yasa asti nāmakam, “O Lord”, “O Maheśvara”, “O Bhagavān”, “O God”, “O Śiva”, “O my dear”, “dearest”, these names are glorified in that tongue, and praṇāmāṅkaśca śirasi, and the sign of bowing down on the earth before You, and the sign on the forehead of bowing . . .

verses.iast: sadasac ca bhavān eva yena tenāprayāsataḥ / svarasenaiva bhagavaṃs tathā siddhiḥ kathaṃ na me
verses.devanagari: सदसच् च भवान् एव येन तेनाप्रयासतः / स्वरसेनैव भगवंस् तथा सिद्धिः कथं न मे
verses.english: O Lord, this is a fact that You are, in existing objects, You are existing, and in non-existent objects, You are existing. In those objects, which are not existing, You exist; in those objects, which are existing, You exist. In those objects, which are fully lighted, You exist; in those objects, which are in the dark, You exist. You are in darkness, You are in light. You are in existing objects and You are in non-existent objects.

verses.iast: śivadāsaḥ śivaikātmā kiṃ yan nāsādayet sukham / tarpyo 'smi devamukhyānām api yenāmṛtāsavaiḥ
verses.devanagari: शिवदासः शिवैकात्मा किं यन् नासादयेत् सुखम् / तर्प्यो ऽस्मि देवमुख्यानाम् अपि येनामृतासवैः
verses.english: I am a slave of Lord Śiva. It is a fact. I am just His slave. I am not only a slave, I am myself Śiva, śivaikātmā [laughter]! Kiṁ yat nā sādayet sukham, and that person who has become like that, he will enjoy all sorts of enjoyments, all sorts of bliss. So, it is a fact that deva mukhyānāma, all these five great lords have to come and devote [themselves] to me.

verses.iast: hṛnnābhyor antarālasthaḥ prāṇināṃ pittavigrahaḥ / grasase tvaṃ mahāvahniḥ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
verses.devanagari: हृन्नाभ्योर् अन्तरालस्थः प्राणिनां पित्तविग्रहः / ग्रससे त्वं महावह्निः सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्
verses.english: O Lord, You have become that fire, which is existing in the center of the belly of each and every being; that fire, which is situated in the center of each and every being, in the belly, in the center of the belly of each and every being, and there You eat whatever is moving and whatever is not moving. You eat everything! Everything goes [in that fire] and is digested by You.

chapters.label: Chapter Eleven
chapters.title: Longing for the Nearness of God Autsukyaviśvasitanāmaikādaśaṁ stotram

verses.iast: jagad idam athavā suhṛdo bandhujano vā na bhavati mama kim api / tvaṃ punar etat sarvaṃ yadā tadā ko 'paro me 'stu
verses.devanagari: जगद् इदम् अथवा सुहृदो बन्धुजनो वा न भवति मम किम् अपि / त्वं पुनर् एतत् सर्वं यदा तदा को ऽपरो मे ऽस्तु
verses.english: This whole universe, my kith and kin, my friends, my relatives, I have no one in this world. I have no universe, I have no baby, no Viresh, no John, nothing [belongs] to me. I have no concern with anything, [no] concern with anybody here in this universe.

verses.iast: svāmin maheśvaras tvaṃ sākṣāt sarvaṃ jagat tvam eveti / vastv eva siddhim etv iti yācñā tatrāpi yācñaiva
verses.devanagari: स्वामिन् महेश्वरस् त्वं साक्षात् सर्वं जगत् त्वम् एवेति / वस्त्व् एव सिद्धिम् एत्व् इति याच्ञा तत्रापि याच्ञैव
verses.english: O my Master, You are the Lord of lords. It is a fact, You are the Lord of lords. Sākṣāt sarvaṁ jagattvameveti, this whole universe is just one with You. Why should I ask for anything from You? Why should I ask for anything? Give me everything! I don’t want one thing [laughter]. Give me everything! You are Maheśvara, You are the Lord of lords. Everything will come out [from You]. Why should I ask for some particular thing from You? I will never ask [You for] a particular thing.

verses.iast: tribhuvanādhipatitvam apīha yat tṛṇam iva pratibhāti bhavajjuṣaḥ / kim iva tasya phalaṃ śubhakarmaṇo bhavati nātha bhavatsmaraṇād ṛte
verses.devanagari: त्रिभुवनाधिपतित्वम् अपीह यत् तृणम् इव प्रतिभाति भवज्जुषः / किम् इव तस्य फलं शुभकर्मणो भवति नाथ भवत्स्मरणाद् ऋते
verses.english: Nātha, O Master, this tribhuvanādhi pati tvam api, in this world, the kingdom of all the three worlds appears to Thy devotees, to Thy bhavat juṣaḥ, adorers.

verses.iast: yena naiva bhavato 'sti vibhinnaṃ kiñcanāpi jagatāṃ prabhavaś ca / tvadvijṛmbhitam ato 'dbhutakarmasv apy udeti na tava stutibandhaḥ
verses.devanagari: येन नैव भवतो ऽस्ति विभिन्नं किञ्चनापि जगतां प्रभवश् च / त्वद्विजृम्भितम् अतो ऽद्भुतकर्मस्व् अप्य् उदेति न तव स्तुतिबन्धः
verses.english: It is a fact that bhavataḥ vibhinnaṁ kiñcana na asti, there is nothing outside Your svarūpa, there is nothing existing without Thee. Only You are existing and nothing else in this world. And jagatāṁ prabhavaśca tvad vijṛmbhitam, the handlers of this whole universe, those five handlers of this universe–creators, protectors, destroyers, concealers, and revealers (Brahma, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Īśvara, and Sadāśiva)–those great gods, those five handlers of this universe, are also tvatvijṛmbhitam, just offshoots of Your divine divinity. [They] are only offshoots, just sparks of Thy divinity.

verses.iast: tvanmayo 'smi bhavadarcananiṣṭhaḥ sarvadāham iti cāpy avirāmam / bhāvayann api vibho svarasena svapnago 'pi na tathā kim iva syām
verses.devanagari: त्वन्मयो ऽस्मि भवदर्चननिष्ठः सर्वदाहम् इति चाप्य् अविरामम् / भावयन्न् अपि विभो स्वरसेन स्वप्नगो ऽपि न तथा किम् इव स्याम्
verses.english: O Lord, there is one problem in me. That is, there is [never] such a moment when I don’t adore You, when I don’t adore You wholeheartedly! Tvanmayo’smi, I am always with You! I am always thinking of You. I am always possessing You. Every now and then160, I am with You and I am worshiping You always. Iti cāpi avirāmambhavayannapi, and this I am perceiving in this universe, that I am worshiping You as my Lord, dearest Lord, and that, I perceive that.

verses.iast: ye manāg api bhavaccaraṇābjodbhūtasaurabhalavena vimṛṣṭaḥ / teṣu visram iva bhavati samastaṃ bhogajātam amarair api mṛgyam
verses.devanagari: ये मनाग् अपि भवच्चरणाब्जोद्भूतसौरभलवेन विमृष्टः / तेषु विस्रम् इव भवति समस्तं भोगजातम् अमरैर् अपि मृग्यम्
verses.english: Those people who are touched by bhavat caraṇābja udbhūta saurabhalavena, who have got contact with the fragrance, with just a small particle of the fragrance, which has come out from the lotus feet of Thee, from Your lotus feet–that fragrance, that pollen, which has come out from Thy lotus feet–and with that pollen, by that pollen, those who are manāgapi, just slightly vimṛṣṭaḥ, touched (vimṛṣtaḥ means “just touched”), and in those people, teṣu visramiva bhāti samastaṁ bhogajātam, all that enjoyment found in amaraiḥ, found by the gods in heaven, that enjoyment, all that enjoyment, the world of enjoyment appears to them as visram (visram means “[having] a foul smell”). They just think of that enjoyment and put this [Swamiji covers his nose]. They can’t look at it.

verses.iast: hṛdi te na tu vidyate 'nyad anyad vacane karmaṇi cānyad eva śaṃbho / paramārthasato 'py anugraho vā yadi vā nigraha eka eva kāryaḥ
verses.devanagari: हृदि ते न तु विद्यते ऽन्यद् अन्यद् वचने कर्मणि चान्यद् एव शंभो / परमार्थसतो ऽप्य् अनुग्रहो वा यदि वा निग्रह एक एव कार्यः
verses.english: You see, I am a simple man, I have no fraud in me. You know that. You must also possess that state. But, You seem to be a fraud sometimes! Because, hṛdi te na tu vidyate, it is not a fraud[ulent] action when whatever [you] do is also existing in your mind; hṛdi te, the same thing must exist in your speech, in your word. Whatever is existing in your mind, the same thing must exist in your word and the same thing must exist in your action. But, I feel that in Your mind, You have some [idea] of doing something [else] in connection with Your devotees. You say, outwardly You say, “I will do it” but internally You think, “I won’t do it”.

verses.iast: mūḍho 'smi duḥkhakalito 'smi jarādidoṣabhīto 'smi śaktirahito 'smi tavāśrito 'smi / śambho tathā kalaya śīghram upaimi yena sarvottamāṃ dhuram apojjhitaduḥkhamārgaḥ
verses.devanagari: मूढो ऽस्मि दुःखकलितो ऽस्मि जरादिदोषभीतो ऽस्मि शक्तिरहितो ऽस्मि तवाश्रितो ऽस्मि / शम्भो तथा कलय शीघ्रम् उपैमि येन सर्वोत्तमां धुरम् अपोज्झितदुःखमार्गः
verses.english: O Lord, I am dull-headed. Actually, I am dull-headed. I don’t know how to talk with You (mūḍho’smi). You see, I am duḥkha kalito’smi, I am overwhelmed with sadness. I am always sad. I am dull-headed. It is a fact that I am dull-headed and I am sad.

verses.iast: tvatkarṇadeśama dhiśayya mahārghabhāvam ākranditāni mama tucchatarāṇi yānti / vaṃśāntarālapatitāni jalaikadeśakhaṇḍāni mauktikamaṇitvam ivodvahanti
verses.devanagari: त्वत्कर्णदेशम धिशय्य महार्घभावम् आक्रन्दितानि मम तुच्छतराणि यान्ति / वंशान्तरालपतितानि जलैकदेशखण्डानि मौक्तिकमणित्वम् इवोद्वहन्ति
verses.english: O Lord, just as vaṁśāntarāla patitajalaikadesa khaṇḍāni, when there is a soft rain and those drops of rain fall into the hollow of that bamboo, the bamboo hollows (i.e., the bamboos [which] are burnt by dāvānala), . . .

verses.iast: kim iva ca labhyate bata na tair api nātha janaiḥ kṣaṇam api kaitavād api ca ye tava nāmni ratāḥ / śiśiramayūkhaśekhara tathā kuru yena mama kṣatamaraṇo 'ṇimādikam upaimi yathā vibhavam
verses.devanagari: किम् इव च लभ्यते बत न तैर् अपि नाथ जनैः क्षणम् अपि कैतवाद् अपि च ये तव नाम्नि रताः / शिशिरमयूखशेखर तथा कुरु येन मम क्षतमरणो ऽणिमादिकम् उपैमि यथा विभवम्
verses.english: Nātha, O Lord, kimiva ca labhyate vata na tairapi nātha janaiḥ, those people, can’t they achieve [anything]? They can achieve everything! Those people can achieve everything! Whatever is possible and whatever is impossible, they will achieve that. Who? Kṣaṇamapi kaitavādi api ca ye tava, those who have diverted their minds in Your remembrance, not with devotion, but with deceit, just to please You.

verses.iast: śambho śarva śaśaṅkaśekhara śiva tryakṣākṣamālādhara śrīmann ugrakapālalāñchana lasadbhīmatriśūlāyudha / kāruṇyāmbunidhe trilokaracanāśīlograśaktyātmaka śrīkaṇṭhāśu vināśayāśubhabharān ādhat svasiddhiṃ parām
verses.devanagari: शम्भो शर्व शशङ्कशेखर शिव त्र्यक्षाक्षमालाधर श्रीमन्न् उग्रकपाललाञ्छन लसद्भीमत्रिशूलायुध / कारुण्याम्बुनिधे त्रिलोकरचनाशीलोग्रशक्त्यात्मक श्रीकण्ठाशु विनाशयाशुभभरान् आधत् स्वसिद्धिं पराम्
verses.english: O Lord Śiva! O destroyer of the whole universe! Śaśāṅkaśekhara, O holder of the crescent moon on Your forehead! O Śiva! O Śiva! Tryakṣa, O holder of three eyes! Akṣamālā dharaḥ, O holder of these beads (japa malā)! Śrīman, O holder of the wealth of liberation! Ugra kapāla lāñchana, O holder of the terrifying kapāla (skull)!

verses.iast: tat kiṃ nātha bhaven na yatra bhagavān nirmātṛtām aśnute bhāvaḥ syāt kim u tasya cetanavato nāśāsti yaṃ śaṅkaraḥ / itthaṃ te parameśvarākṣatamahāśakteḥ sadā saṃśritaḥ saṃsāre 'tra nirantarādhividhuraḥ kliśyāmy ahaṃ kevalam
verses.devanagari: तत् किं नाथ भवेन् न यत्र भगवान् निर्मातृताम् अश्नुते भावः स्यात् किम् उ तस्य चेतनवतो नाशास्ति यं शङ्करः / इत्थं ते परमेश्वराक्षतमहाशक्तेः सदा संश्रितः संसारे ऽत्र निरन्तराधिविधुरः क्लिश्याम्य् अहं केवलम्
verses.english: Nātha, O Lord, tat kiṁ bhavet, yatra bhagavān nirmātṛtām na aśnute, what is that object where Lord Śiva (or You, Thou) art not the creator? You create everything. Whatever is existing in this universe, You are its creator. And bhāvaḥ syāt kimu tasya cetanavato nāśāsti yaṁ śaṅkaraḥ, and what is that object, which is not governed and ruled out by You, Śaṅkara?

verses.iast: yady apy atra varapradoddhatatamāḥ pīḍājarāmṛtyava ete vā kṣaṇam āsatāṃ bahumataḥ śabdādir evāsthiraḥ / tatrāpi spṛhayāmi santatasukhākāṅkṣī ciraṃ sthāsnave bhogāsvādayutatvadaṅghrikamaladhyānāgrya jīvātave
verses.devanagari: यद्य् अप्य् अत्र वरप्रदोद्धततमाः पीडाजरामृत्यव एते वा क्षणम् आसतां बहुमतः शब्दादिर् एवास्थिरः / तत्रापि स्पृहयामि सन्ततसुखाकाङ्क्षी चिरं स्थास्नवे भोगास्वादयुतत्वदङ्घ्रिकमलध्यानाग्र्य जीवातवे
verses.english: Varaprada, O bestower of boons (“varaprada” is āmantraṇam169), O bestower of boons, O Lord Śiva, although in this universe, pīdā (crisis, pain, unending pain), jarā (old age), and mṛtyava (death) are supposed to be uddhatatamāḥ, frightening (uddhata tamāḥ, very, extremely, frightening, unbearable)–sadness, old age, and death–ete vā kṣaṇamāsatām, let [us not] touch upon this topic. Let these three things remain aside, on one side.

verses.iast: he nātha praṇatārtināśanapaṭo śreyonidhe dhūrjaṭe duḥkhaikāyatanasya janmamaraṇatrastasya me sāmpratam / tac ceṣṭasva yathā manojñaviṣayāsvādapradā uttamā jīvann eva samaśnuve 'ham acalāḥ siddhīs tvadarcāparaḥ
verses.devanagari: हे नाथ प्रणतार्तिनाशनपटो श्रेयोनिधे धूर्जटे दुःखैकायतनस्य जन्ममरणत्रस्तस्य मे साम्प्रतम् / तच् चेष्टस्व यथा मनोज्ञविषयास्वादप्रदा उत्तमा जीवन्न् एव समश्नुवे ऽहम् अचलाः सिद्धीस् त्वदर्चापरः
verses.english: He nātha, O my Master, praṇatārtināśanapaṭah, O my Lord who is bent upon removing and destroying the torture of those who have taken Your refuge–[for those] who have taken Your refuge, You are bent upon destroying their pain, torture–śreyonidhe, O ocean of peace (kalyāṇa,171 beatitude; śreyaḥ means “beatitude”; beatitude is final liberation), dhūrjaṭe, O jaṭā juta, dhūrjaṭe, who has got (dhūrjaṭe means those [matted locks that] you find in sādhus172) . . .

verses.iast: namo mohamahādhvāntadhvaṃsanānanyakarmaṇe / sarvaprakāśātiśayaprakāśāyendulakṣmaṇe
verses.devanagari: नमो मोहमहाध्वान्तध्वंसनानन्यकर्मणे / सर्वप्रकाशातिशयप्रकाशायेन्दुलक्ष्मणे
verses.english: I bow to Thee who has only this much to do.

chapters.label: Chapter Twelve
chapters.title: Revealing the Secret Rahasyanirdeśanāma dvādaśaṁ stotram

verses.iast: sahakāri na kiñcid iṣyate bhavato na pratibandhakaṃ dṛṣi / bhavataiva hi sarvam āplutaṃ katham adyāpi tathāpi nekṣase
verses.devanagari: सहकारि न किञ्चिद् इष्यते भवतो न प्रतिबन्धकं दृषि / भवतैव हि सर्वम् आप्लुतं कथम् अद्यापि तथापि नेक्षसे
verses.english: Bhavato dṛśi, for finding You, my Lord, for finding You out, for experiencing Your nature, sahakāri na kiñcit iṣyate, there is nothing to be adopted. For perceiving You, there is nothing to be adopted. You are perceived just, i.e., just without any adoption, just without meditation, just without prayers, just without concentration, just without dhyāna, just without maintaining discipline. There is nothing needed in perceiving You.

verses.iast: api bhāvagaṇād apīndriyapracayād apy avabodhamadhyataḥ / prabhavantam api svataḥ sadā paripaśyeyam apoḍhaviśvakam
verses.devanagari: अपि भावगणाद् अपीन्द्रियप्रचयाद् अप्य् अवबोधमध्यतः / प्रभवन्तम् अपि स्वतः सदा परिपश्येयम् अपोढविश्वकम्
verses.english: O Lord, bhāvagaṇāt api, from the objective world, indriya pracayāt api, from the collection of the organic world176, avabodha madhyataḥ, and from the center of the cognitive world, prabhavantamapi svataḥ sadā, I would like to feel You automatically, always.

verses.iast: kathaṃ te jāyeran katham api ca te darśanapathaṃ vrajeyuḥ kenāpi prakṛtimahatāṅkena khacitaḥ / tathotthāyotthāya sthalajalatṛṇāder akhilataḥ padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair(?) vikirasi
verses.devanagari: कथं ते जायेरन् कथम् अपि च ते दर्शनपथं व्रजेयुः केनापि प्रकृतिमहताङ्केन खचितः / तथोत्थायोत्थाय स्थलजलतृणादेर् अखिलतः पदार्थद्यान्सृष्टिस्रवदमृतपूरैर्(?) विकिरसि
verses.english: O Lord, how can those fortunate persons again be born in this universe? And how can those fortunate persons be understood by worldly people? Worldly people can never understand them. Beyond understanding, they are beyond understanding to worldly people. Worldly people cannot understand that they are so high, they are so highly elevated. And how can they come again in this birth?

verses.iast: sākṣatkṛta bhavadrūpaprasṛtāmṛtatarpitāḥ / unmūlitatṛṣo mattā vicaranti yathāruci
verses.devanagari: साक्षत्कृत भवद्रूपप्रसृतामृततर्पिताः / उन्मूलिततृषो मत्ता विचरन्ति यथारुचि
verses.english: In this world, I have found that there are some mad people who enjoy roaming here and there in this world according to their choice–with their choice, with their own independent will, they roam here and there–and unmūlitatṛśā, and they have no thirst for anything, they have no thirst for any object, be it śabda (sound), sparśa (touch), rūpa (form), rasa (taste), or gan-dha (smell). Without thirst, they enjoy in this universe just like mad people.

verses.iast: na tadā na sadā na caikadety api sā yatra na kāladhīr bhavet / tad idaṃ bhavadīyadarśanaṃ na ca nityaṃ na ca kathyate 'nyathā
verses.devanagari: न तदा न सदा न चैकदेत्य् अपि सा यत्र न कालधीर् भवेत् / तद् इदं भवदीयदर्शनं न च नित्यं न च कथ्यते ऽन्यथा
verses.english: In the real sense, this is the only sign of experiencing Your nature (tat idaṁ bhavadīya darśanam).

verses.iast: tvadvilokanasamutkacetaso yogasiddhir iyatī sadāstu me / yad viśeyam abhisandhimātratas tvatsudhāsadanam arcanāya te
verses.devanagari: त्वद्विलोकनसमुत्कचेतसो योगसिद्धिर् इयती सदास्तु मे / यद् विशेयम् अभिसन्धिमात्रतस् त्वत्सुधासदनम् अर्चनाय ते
verses.english: O Lord, I want only one yogic power. I want to own one yogic power and for always. This power I must own for always. Only this much. Only one small thing, which I want to own and that is yoga siddhi, only one yoga siddhi.

verses.iast: nirvikalpabhavadīyadarśanapraptiphullamanasāṃ mahātmanām / ullasanti vimalāni helayā ceṣṭitāni ca vacāṃsi ca sphuṭam
verses.devanagari: निर्विकल्पभवदीयदर्शनप्रप्तिफुल्लमनसां महात्मनाम् / उल्लसन्ति विमलानि हेलया चेष्टितानि च वचांसि च स्फुटम्
verses.english: And those great souls whose mind has bloomed, whose mind is phulla manasāṁ, whose mind has bloomed by attaining, by the achievement, of Your nirvikalpa darśana . . .

verses.iast: bhavanbhavadīyapādayor nivasann antara eva nirbhayaḥ / bhavabhūmiṣu tāsu tāsv ahaṃ prabhum arceyam anargalakriyaḥ
verses.devanagari: भवन्भवदीयपादयोर् निवसन्न् अन्तर एव निर्भयः / भवभूमिषु तासु तास्व् अहं प्रभुम् अर्चेयम् अनर्गलक्रियः
verses.english: O Lord, there is one problem with me. That is, I want to reside, I want to live, under Your feet, under Your divine feet. I want to live there, under Your divine feet.

verses.iast: bhavadaṅghrisaroruhodare parilīno galitaparaiṣaṇaḥ / atimātramadhūpayogataḥ paritṛpto vicareyam icchayā
verses.devanagari: भवदङ्घ्रिसरोरुहोदरे परिलीनो गलितपरैषणः / अतिमात्रमधूपयोगतः परितृप्तो विचरेयम् इच्छया
verses.english: O Lord, bhavat aṅghri sarorūha udare parilīnāḥ, I would like to rest under Your lotus feet. I would like to rest under Your lotus feet and where galitā apara iṣaṇaḥ, where I will find no other desire in me. No other desire will remain in me. All other desires will vanish altogether.

verses.iast: yasya dambhād iva bhavatpūjāsaṅkalpa utthitaḥ / tasyāpy avaśyam uditaṃ sannidhānaṃ tavocitam
verses.devanagari: यस्य दम्भाद् इव भवत्पूजासङ्कल्प उत्थितः / तस्याप्य् अवश्यम् उदितं सन्निधानं तवोचितम्
verses.english: That person who desires to adore Your nature just for curiosity, just to show people that he is an adorer of Lord Śiva (i.e., just a fraud, fraudulently184)–bhavat pūjā saṁkalpaḥ, and he is worshiping Thee, he worships You, just to show people that he is worshiping You–[nevertheless, the act of] Your worship is so great that to him also, You will become divine.185 Tasya api avaśyamuditaṁ sannidhānaṁ tavocitam, You will appear to him in the state of God consciousness; he will also achieve God consciousness. This is the greatness of Your nature. [Even one] who just touches [Thy worship] with a crooked thought, he will also attain that supreme joy.

verses.iast: bhagavann itarān apekṣiṇā nitarām ekarasena cetasā / sulabhaṃ sakalopaśāyinaṃ prabhum ātṛpti pibeyam asmi kim
verses.devanagari: भगवन्न् इतरान् अपेक्षिणा नितराम् एकरसेन चेतसा / सुलभं सकलोपशायिनं प्रभुम् आतृप्ति पिबेयम् अस्मि किम्
verses.english: Bhagavan, O Lord, there is one desire in me and that desire must be fulfilled. That is, I want to swallow You, up to my entire satisfaction. When will that day come, when will that moment come, when I would swallow You in my own nature, up to my entire satisfaction? You who are sakalopaśāyinam, You who are found everywhere, You are everywhere found and I want to swallow You at once!

verses.iast: tvayā nirākṛtam sarvaṃ heyam etat tad eva tu / tvanmayaṃ samupādeyam ity ayaṃ sārasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.devanagari: त्वया निराकृतम् सर्वं हेयम् एतत् तद् एव तु / त्वन्मयं समुपादेयम् इत्य् अयं सारसंग्रहः
verses.english: In brief words, the essence of this philosophy is this that tvayā nirākṛtaṁ sarvaṁ, everything, where[ever] You are not found, that is to be abandoned. Whatever [it is]–it may be jewelry, it may be gold, it may be a kingdom, it may be sovereignty–it is to be abandoned when You are not [found] there. And when You are there, when You are present–it may be anything absurd–it is worth having.186 Ityeyaṁ sāra saṅgrahaḥ, this is, in brief words, the essence of our philosophy.

verses.iast: bhavato 'ntaracāri bhāvajātaṃ prabhuvanmukhyatayaiva pūjitaṃ tat / bhavato bahir apy abhāvamātrā katham īśān bhavet samarcyate vā
verses.devanagari: भवतो ऽन्तरचारि भावजातं प्रभुवन्मुख्यतयैव पूजितं तत् / भवतो बहिर् अप्य् अभावमात्रा कथम् ईशान् भवेत् समर्च्यते वा
verses.english: “Īśāna” is āmantraṇam188.

verses.iast: niḥśabdaṃ nirvikalpaṃ ca nirvyākṣepam athānisam / kṣobhe 'py adhyakṣamī kṣeyaṃ tryakṣa tvām eva sarvataḥ
verses.devanagari: निःशब्दं निर्विकल्पं च निर्व्याक्षेपम् अथानिसम् / क्षोभे ऽप्य् अध्यक्षमी क्षेयं त्र्यक्ष त्वाम् एव सर्वतः
verses.english: “Tryakṣa” is āmantraṇam.190

verses.iast: prakaṭaya nijadhāma deva yasmiṃs tvam asi sadā parameśvarīsametaḥ / prabhucaraṇarajaḥsamānakakṣyāḥ kim aviśvāsapadaṃ bhānti bhṛtyāḥ
verses.devanagari: प्रकटय निजधाम देव यस्मिंस् त्वम् असि सदा परमेश्वरीसमेतः / प्रभुचरणरजःसमानकक्ष्याः किम् अविश्वासपदं भान्ति भृत्याः
verses.english: Deva, O Lord, prakaṭaya nija dhāma, please reveal that abode of Yourself where You are residing along with Your Goddess, along with Pārvatī (yasmin, in which residence; tvaṁ, You are residing; parameśvarī sametaḥ, along with Your better half, Pārvati).

verses.iast: darśanapatham upayāto 'py apasarasi kuto mameśa bhṛtyasya / kṣaṇamātrakam iha na bhavasi kasya na jantor dṛśor viṣayaḥ
verses.devanagari: दर्शनपथम् उपयातो ऽप्य् अपसरसि कुतो ममेश भृत्यस्य / क्षणमात्रकम् इह न भवसि कस्य न जन्तोर् दृशोर् विषयः
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, You have come to see me; darśana patham upayāto api, You have come to see me today. It is my great fortune that You have come to see me. But, just when You open the door of my kuṭi (my hut) to come in, then, from that doorway, You are again returning to Your home. What is the fun in coming to see me in that way?

verses.iast: aikyasaṃvidamṛtācchadhārayā santataprasṛtayā kadā vibho / plāvanāt paramabhedamānayaṃs tvāṃ nijaṃ ca vapur āpnuyāṃ mudam
verses.devanagari: ऐक्यसंविदमृताच्छधारया सन्ततप्रसृतया कदा विभो / प्लावनात् परमभेदमानयंस् त्वां निजं च वपुर् आप्नुयां मुदम्
verses.english: In fact, in my mind, this desire is knocking in the background of my mind. That is, O Lord, aikyasaṁvit amṛta acchadhārayā santata prasṛtayā kadā vibho plāvanāt, I want to be over-flooded by that flood, great flood, which is aikyasaṁvid amṛtācchadhārayā, which is flowing the stream of the nectar of oneness, non-dualism; that is, flowing the stream of the nectar of non-dualism. I want to get flooded by that.

verses.iast: aham ity amuto 'varuddhalokād bhavadīyāt pratipattisārato me / aṇumātrakam eva viśvaniṣṭhaṃ ghaṭatāṃ yena bhaveyam arcitā te
verses.devanagari: अहम् इत्य् अमुतो ऽवरुद्धलोकाद् भवदीयात् प्रतिपत्तिसारतो मे / अणुमात्रकम् एव विश्वनिष्ठं घटतां येन भवेयम् अर्चिता ते
verses.english: O Lord, aham iti amuto avaruddhalokāt bhavadīyāt prātipattisārato me, there is one desire in me and that is, I would like to have just one particle–one tiny, smallest, particle–from the essence of Your God consciousness, from the essence of Your knowledge, unity of knowledge. From that unity of knowledge, I would like to have just a minute particle of that knowledge. And that knowledge is perfect universal I-consciousness (ahamiti). And where avaruddhalokāt, where all differentiated perceptions are vanished, have vanished. I would like to have one particle from That; aṇumātrakam, only just a minute one, just the smallest particle from That consciousness, God consciousness. And that particle must not [exclude] universal consciousness. Universal consciousness also must be united with that God consciousness.

verses.iast: aparimitarūpam ahaṃ taṃ taṃ bhāvaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ paśyan / tvām eva viśvarūpaṃ nijanāthaṃ sādhu paśyeyam
verses.devanagari: अपरिमितरूपम् अहं तं तं भावं प्रतिक्षणं पश्यन् / त्वाम् एव विश्वरूपं निजनाथं साधु पश्येयम्
verses.english: The same thing he clarifies in this next śloka.

verses.iast: bhavadaṅgagataṃ tam eva kasmān na manaḥ paryaṭatīṣṭam artham artham / prakṛtikṣatir asti no tathāsya mama cecchā paripūryate paraiva
verses.devanagari: भवदङ्गगतं तम् एव कस्मान् न मनः पर्यटतीष्टम् अर्थम् अर्थम् / प्रकृतिक्षतिर् अस्ति नो तथास्य मम चेच्छा परिपूर्यते परैव
verses.english: Why should I delete194 objective perception? I would never like to delete objective perception. I would never abandon objective perception because worldly objects are actually Your own private limbs of Your body. Bhavat aṅgagatam, this is Your aṅga, it is the limbs of Your body.

verses.iast: śataśaḥ kila te tavānubhāvād bhagavan ke 'py amunaiva cakṣuṣā ye / api hālikaceṣṭayā carantaḥ paripaśyanti bhavadvapuḥ sadāgre
verses.devanagari: शतशः किल ते तवानुभावाद् भगवन् के ऽप्य् अमुनैव चक्षुषा ये / अपि हालिकचेष्टया चरन्तः परिपश्यन्ति भवद्वपुः सदाग्रे
verses.english: . . . śataśaḥ kila te tavānubhāvāt, by Your grace (tavānubhāvāt, by Your grace), I have seen hundreds of [Your] devotees like that, bhagavan, O Lord, ke’pi, and they are very unique. Those hundreds of devotees I have seen, I have come across, and they are Your devotees and they feel amunā eva cakṣuṣā, with these very eyes, with these, their own eyes, they see api hālikaceṣṭayā carantaḥ, while doing activities, while doing degraded activities of the world, . . .

verses.iast: na sā matir udeti yā na bhavati tvadicchāmayī sadā śubham athetarad bhagavataivam ācaryate / ato 'smi bhavadātmako bhuvi yathā tathā sañcaran sthi to 'niśam abādhitatvadamalaṅghripūjotsavaḥ
verses.devanagari: न सा मतिर् उदेति या न भवति त्वदिच्छामयी सदा शुभम् अथेतरद् भगवतैवम् आचर्यते / अतो ऽस्मि भवदात्मको भुवि यथा तथा सञ्चरन् स्थि तो ऽनिशम् अबाधितत्वदमलङ्घ्रिपूजोत्सवः
verses.english: Alright, don’t give [it to] me! I have already achieved this kind of state. If you don’t give [it to] me, I have still achieved this state.

verses.iast: bhavadīyagabhīrabhāṣiteṣu pratibhā samyag udetu me puro 'taḥ / tadanuṣṭhitaśaktir apy atas tadbhavadarcāvyasanaṃ ca nirvirāmam
verses.devanagari: भवदीयगभीरभाषितेषु प्रतिभा सम्यग् उदेतु मे पुरो ऽतः / तदनुष्ठितशक्तिर् अप्य् अतस् तद्भवदर्चाव्यसनं च निर्विरामम्
verses.english: Now, there is a problem in me. There is another . . .

verses.iast: vyavahārapade 'pi sarvadā pratibhātv arthakalāpa eṣa mām / bhavato 'vayavo yathā na tu svata evādaraṇīyatāṃ gataḥ
verses.devanagari: व्यवहारपदे ऽपि सर्वदा प्रतिभात्व् अर्थकलाप एष माम् / भवतो ऽवयवो यथा न तु स्वत एवादरणीयतां गतः
verses.english: O Lord, in this worldly activity, let all of these worldly objects appear to me as they appear to others, i.e., those who are not realized, unrealized people also. Like that, let these worldly objects appear to me.

verses.iast: manasi svarasena yatra tatra pracaraty apy aham asya gocareṣu / prasṛto 'py avilola eva yuṣmatparicaryācaturaḥ sadā bhaveyam
verses.devanagari: मनसि स्वरसेन यत्र तत्र प्रचरत्य् अप्य् अहम् अस्य गोचरेषु / प्रसृतो ऽप्य् अविलोल एव युष्मत्परिचर्याचतुरः सदा भवेयम्
verses.english: There is one problem: I don’t want to control my mind because the mind is so swift, you cannot control it. It can’t be controlled by even the gods, i.e., the mind.

verses.iast: bhagavan bhavadicchayaiva dāsas tava jāto 'smi parasya nātra śaktiḥ / katham eṣa tathāpi vaktrabimbaṃ tava paśyāmi na jātu citram etat
verses.devanagari: भगवन् भवदिच्छयैव दासस् तव जातो ऽस्मि परस्य नात्र शक्तिः / कथम् एष तथापि वक्त्रबिम्बं तव पश्यामि न जातु चित्रम् एतत्
verses.english: O Lord, by Your own will, You have made me Your slave. I didn’t ask You to put me on Your path. I never wished [for that]. It was Your own free will that You have kept me on Your path and You have made me Your slave.

verses.iast: samutsukās tvāṃ prati ye bhavantaṃ pratyartharūpād avalokayanti / teṣām aho kiṃ tadupasthitaṃ syāt kiṃ sādhanaṃ vā phalitaṃ bhavet tat
verses.devanagari: समुत्सुकास् त्वां प्रति ये भवन्तं प्रत्यर्थरूपाद् अवलोकयन्ति / तेषाम् अहो किं तदुपस्थितं स्यात् किं साधनं वा फलितं भवेत् तत्
verses.english: This is a wonder to me. This thing is a wonder to me. In this matter, I am lost. I can’t understand how it happens.

verses.iast: bhāvā bhāvatayā santu bhavadbhāvena me bhava / tathā na kiñcid apy astu na kiñcid bhavato 'nyathā
verses.devanagari: भावा भावतया सन्तु भवद्भावेन मे भव / तथा न किञ्चिद् अप्य् अस्तु न किञ्चिद् भवतो ऽन्यथा
verses.english: There is one desire in me. Let the objective world be perceived by me in its existent way (bhāvatayā). Let the non-existent world remain non-existent to me because it is not existing. That world, which is not one with You, is not-existing. That world, which is one with You, is existing.

verses.iast: yan na kiñcid api tanna kiñcid apy astu kiñcid api kiñcid eva me / sarvathā bhavatu tāvatā bhavān sarvato bhavati labdhapūjitaḥ
verses.devanagari: यन् न किञ्चिद् अपि तन्न किञ्चिद् अप्य् अस्तु किञ्चिद् अपि किञ्चिद् एव मे / सर्वथा भवतु तावता भवान् सर्वतो भवति लब्धपूजितः
verses.english: Whatever is not existing, that is not existing; whatever is existing, that is existing. So, in this way, let me perceive this objective world. Let me perceive the objective world in this way: that object, which is not existing, is not existing; that object, which is existing, is existing.

chapters.label: Chapter Thirteen
chapters.title: In Summary . . .

verses.iast: saṃgrahena sukhaduḥkhalakṣaṇaṃ māṃ prati sthitam idaṃ śṛṇu prabho / saukhyam eṣa bhavatā samāgamaḥ svāminā viraha eva duḥkhitā
verses.devanagari: संग्रहेन सुखदुःखलक्षणं मां प्रति स्थितम् इदं शृणु प्रभो / सौख्यम् एष भवता समागमः स्वामिना विरह एव दुःखिता
verses.english: Prabho, O Lord, in brief words, I will give you the definition of my pain and pleasure.

verses.iast: antar apy atitarām aṇīyasī yā tvadaprathanakālikāsti me / tām apīśa parimṛjya sarvataḥ svaṃ svarūpam amalaṃ prakāśaya
verses.devanagari: अन्तर् अप्य् अतितराम् अणीयसी या त्वदप्रथनकालिकास्ति मे / ताम् अपीश परिमृज्य सर्वतः स्वं स्वरूपम् अमलं प्रकाशय
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, antarapi atitarāmaṇīyasī yā tvad aprathana kālikāsti me, I have that impurity in my mind, by which impurity, tvad aprathana kālikā; tvad aprathana, You are not appearing to me. I can’t perceive You by that impurity of mine.

verses.iast: tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye / tiṣṭhataḥ satatam arcataḥ prabhuṃ jīvitaṃ mṛtam athānyad astu me
verses.devanagari: तावके वपुषि विश्वनिर्भरे चित्सुधारसमये निरत्यये / तिष्ठतः सततम् अर्चतः प्रभुं जीवितं मृतम् अथान्यद् अस्तु मे
verses.english: O Lord, there is one desire in me, there is one longing in me. That is, tāvake vapuṣi viśvanirbhare citsudhārasamaye niratyaye, Thy body, which is viśvanirbhare, filled with universal consciousness, citsudhārasa maye, filled with the nectar of God consciousness, and everlasting (niratyaye, everlasting, niratyaye), where there is no end (atyaya means “unending”), unending state of Your body, which is filled with universal consciousness and also filled with absolute God consciousness . . .

verses.iast: īśvaro 'ham aham eva rūpavān paṇḍito 'smi subhago 'smi ko 'paraḥ / matsamo 'sti jagatīti śobhate mānitā tvadanurāgiṇaḥ param
verses.devanagari: ईश्वरो ऽहम् अहम् एव रूपवान् पण्डितो ऽस्मि सुभगो ऽस्मि को ऽपरः / मत्समो ऽस्ति जगतीति शोभते मानिता त्वदनुरागिणः परम्
verses.english: “I am the Lord.” “I am beautiful.” “I am charming.” “I am learned.” “I am a scholar.” “Subhaga asmi, I am liked by everybody.” “Who else is parallel to me in this world?” This kind of mānitā, this kind of ego, in the real sense, shines and is appropriate in those who have got love for Thee, bas.

verses.iast: devadeva bhavadadvayāmṛtākhyātisaṃharaṇalabdhajanmanā / tad yathāsthitapadārthasaṃvidā māṃ kuruṣva caraṇārcanocitam
verses.devanagari: देवदेव भवदद्वयामृताख्यातिसंहरणलब्धजन्मना / तद् यथास्थितपदार्थसंविदा मां कुरुष्व चरणार्चनोचितम्
verses.english: O Lord of lords, yathāsthita padārtha saṁvidā, whatever is seen, whatever is perceived (śabda, sparśa, rūpa, rasa, and gandha, all of these five kinds of perceptions), whatever perception is there–it may be touch, it may be taste, it may be smell, it may be something [else]–this perception should be born to me anew. This perception is old perception, e.g., eating, drinking, cheese, everyday cheese. It is boring perception. But this perception must be born afresh.

verses.iast: dhyāyate tad anu dṛśyate tataḥ spṛśyate ca parameśvaraḥ svayam / yatra pūjanamahotsavaḥ sa me sarvadāstu bhavato 'nubhāvataḥ
verses.devanagari: ध्यायते तद् अनु दृश्यते ततः स्पृश्यते च परमेश्वरः स्वयम् / यत्र पूजनमहोत्सवः स मे सर्वदास्तु भवतो ऽनुभावतः
verses.english: There is a point where Parameśvara (Lord Śiva) is being concentrated [upon]–not by effort, not with effort–automatically. There is a state . . . that state comes when you automatically meditate on Lord Śiva. And automatically when you meditate on Lord Śiva, automatically you perceive Lord Śiva, because that is from anugraha206, it is not from your effort. Your effort is useless. I told you once.207

verses.iast: yady athāsthitapadārthadarśanaṃ yuṣmadarcanamahotsavaś ca yaḥ / yugmam etad itaretarāśrayaṃ bhaktiśāliṣu sadā vijṛmbhate
verses.devanagari: यद्य् अथास्थितपदार्थदर्शनं युष्मदर्चनमहोत्सवश् च यः / युग्मम् एतद् इतरेतराश्रयं भक्तिशालिषु सदा विजृम्भते
verses.english: There are two moments of that great festival. One is yathā sthita padārtha darśanam, just śabda, sparśa, rūpa, rasa, and gandha; to feel this object as [being] in the shape of a [microphone], to feel this as [spectacles], to feel this as a book, or to touch, to taste, to hear, to smell . . . all of these organic perceptions. This is one way of the world of perception. This is the perception of the organic world. The organs perceive like that. And there is another world. That is, yuṣmat arcana mahotsavaḥ, that great festival of worshiping You.

verses.iast: tattadindriyamukhena santataṃ yuṣmadarcanarasāyanāsavam / sarvabhāvacaṣakeṣu pūriteṣv āpibann api bhaveyam unmadaḥ
verses.devanagari: तत्तदिन्द्रियमुखेन सन्ततं युष्मदर्चनरसायनासवम् / सर्वभावचषकेषु पूरितेष्व् आपिबन्न् अपि भवेयम् उन्मदः
verses.english: There is one desire in me, O Lord. That desire is, I want to get drunk, I want to get drunk always. Always drunk!

verses.iast: anyavedyam aṇumātram asti na svaprakāśam akhilaṃ vijṛmbhate / yatra nātha bhavataḥ pure sthitaṃ tatra me kuru sadā tavārcituḥ
verses.devanagari: अन्यवेद्यम् अणुमात्रम् अस्ति न स्वप्रकाशम् अखिलं विजृम्भते / यत्र नाथ भवतः पुरे स्थितं तत्र मे कुरु सदा तवार्चितुः
verses.english: O Lord, there is a place, there is one place, one country–in this universe there is one country–where anyavedyam aṇumātram asti, where no other object is felt [as other] than Your God consciousness. That country, in that country where no object is found as other than God consciousness, svaprakāśam akhilaṁ vijṛmbhate, where everything is understood as svaprakāśa, of just transcendental God consciousness and nothing else, in that country, in that bhavataḥ pure, in that country of Thine, in Thine world, let me reside. Let me be . . . let me get the capacity of residence.

verses.iast: dāsadhāmni viniyojito 'py ahaṃ svecchayaiva parameśvara tvayā / darśanena na kim asmi pātritaḥ pādasaṃvahanakarmaṇāpi vā
verses.devanagari: दासधाम्नि विनियोजितो ऽप्य् अहं स्वेच्छयैव परमेश्वर त्वया / दर्शनेन न किम् अस्मि पात्रितः पादसंवहनकर्मणापि वा
verses.english: Parameśvara, O Lord, (“O Lord”, it is āmantraṇam208), Parameśvara, aham tvayā dāsa dhāmani svecchayaiva viniyojitaḥ, I have been kept as, I have been made as Your slave by You by Your own will. I didn’t insist that I would like to be Your slave–I never said that–but You have made me Your slave by Your own will.

verses.iast: śaktipātasamaye vicāraṇaṃ prāptam īśa na karoṣi karhicit / adya māṃ prati kim āgataṃ yataḥ svaprakāśanavidhau vilambase
verses.devanagari: शक्तिपातसमये विचारणं प्राप्तम् ईश न करोषि कर्हिचित् / अद्य मां प्रति किम् आगतं यतः स्वप्रकाशनविधौ विलम्बसे
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, at the time of showering grace, when You bestow grace on Your devotees, at that time, it was necessary for You to think over it first, i.e., if the person whom You shower grace [upon] is worthy to receive it, is capable to receive that grace from You. Na karoṣi karhicit, You never think that way. You never think that way. Bas, You shower grace without thinking if he is fit or capable or not.

verses.iast: tatra tatra viṣaye bahirvibhāty antare ca parameśvarīyutam / tvāṃ jagattritayanirbharaṃ sadā lokayeya nijapāṇipūjitam
verses.devanagari: तत्र तत्र विषये बहिर्विभात्य् अन्तरे च परमेश्वरीयुतम् / त्वां जगत्त्रितयनिर्भरं सदा लोकयेय निजपाणिपूजितम्
verses.english: There is one desire in me, O Lord! Tatra tatra viṣaye bahir vibhāti antare ca, whenever I perceive, when I join in the organs of the senses, when I utilize enjoyment in the organs of the senses, it may be outside or inside (outside enjoyment is just śabda, sparśa, rūpa, rasa, and gandha; inside enjoyment is in impressions, in thoughts)–I do this, it is the automatic way of life, of everybody’s life–but my desire is that I would parameśvarīyutam tvāṁ jagat tritaya nirbharaṁ sadā lokayeya, this is my desire, the only desire, that I want to perceive You along with Pārvatī in those actions, i.e., outward actions and internal actions of sensual enjoyments.

verses.iast: svāmisaudham abhisandhimātrato nirvibandham adhiruhya sarvadā / syāṃ prasāda paramāmṛtāsavāpānakeliparilabdhanirvṛtiḥ
verses.devanagari: स्वामिसौधम् अभिसन्धिमात्रतो निर्विबन्धम् अधिरुह्य सर्वदा / स्यां प्रसाद परमामृतासवापानकेलिपरिलब्धनिर्वृतिः
verses.english: The throne of my Master, my Lord Śiva, I would like to ascend on that throne, not by effort, not with effort, but abhisandhimātrataḥ, whenever I wish, whenever I desire. Whenever I will it, I must ascend to that throne of my Master, nirvibandham, without any obstacles, without any halts (nirvibandham).

verses.iast: yatsamastasubhagārthavastuṣu sparśamātravidhinā camatkṛtim / tāṃ samarpayati tena te vapuḥ pūjayanty acalabhaktiśālinaḥ
verses.devanagari: यत्समस्तसुभगार्थवस्तुषु स्पर्शमात्रविधिना चमत्कृतिम् / तां समर्पयति तेन ते वपुः पूजयन्त्य् अचलभक्तिशालिनः
verses.english: Samasta subhagārthavastuṣu sparśamātra vidhinā camatkṛtiṁ. Whenever we hear sound (not ordinary sound; very beautiful sound, penetrating sound, soft sound), and touch (very intoxicative touch), beautiful form (you perceive beautiful form)–samasta subhagārtha vastuṣu (śubhagārtha means those who are very beautiful), very beautiful śabda, sparśa, rūpa, rasa, and taste [that is] also very beautiful, and gandha, smell also–and in tasting all of these five senses, five beautiful senses, you should avoid those which are not beautiful because [these senses are] meant for worshiping You. We have to worship You. We must not worship You with bad things. We must worship You with good things, with beautiful things.

verses.iast: sphārayasy akhilam ātmanā sphuran viśvam āmṛśasi rūpam āmṛśan / yat svayaṃ nijarasena ghurṇase tat samullasati bhāvamaṇḍalam
verses.devanagari: स्फारयस्य् अखिलम् आत्मना स्फुरन् विश्वम् आमृशसि रूपम् आमृशन् / यत् स्वयं निजरसेन घुर्णसे तत् समुल्लसति भावमण्डलम्
verses.english: O Lord, when You ātmanā sphuran, when Your joy knows no bounds, when You are joyously shining, then the whole universe shines joyously.

verses.iast: yo 'vikalpam idam arthamaṇḍalaṃ paśyatīśa nikhilaṃ bhavadvapuḥ / svātmapakṣaparipūrite jagaty asya nityasukhinaḥ kuto bhayam
verses.devanagari: यो ऽविकल्पम् इदम् अर्थमण्डलं पश्यतीश निखिलं भवद्वपुः / स्वात्मपक्षपरिपूरिते जगत्य् अस्य नित्यसुखिनः कुतो भयम्
verses.english: Īśa, O Lord, any person who perceives this whole universe, this whole objective world, as one with Your nature–paśyatīśa nikhilaṁ bhavadvapuḥ, he feels that this whole objective world is Your own body–and for him, svātma pakṣa paripūrite jagati, for him, this whole universe is filled with God consciousness everywhere. Asya nitya sukhinaḥ, he is always blissful. Kuto bhayam, where there is fear for him? There is no fear for such a person.

verses.iast: kaṇṭhakoṇaviniviṣṭam īśa te kālakūṭam api me mahāmṛtam / apy upāttam amṛtaṃ bhavadvapur bhedavṛtti yadi rocate na me
verses.devanagari: कण्ठकोणविनिविष्टम् ईश ते कालकूटम् अपि मे महामृतम् / अप्य् उपात्तम् अमृतं भवद्वपुर् भेदवृत्ति यदि रोचते न मे
verses.english: O Lord, there is one tremendous poison in Your neck of kālakūṭa [from the time] when You swallowed that kālakūṭa viṣa (poison) at the time of churning this kṣīrasāgara (the ocean of milk, milky ocean223), and that kālakūṭa viṣa appeared from that [ocean] while churning it, and it was tolerated by nobody! Everybody cried and it created a crisis from all sides in heaven. Who could touch it?

verses.iast: tvatpralāpamayaraktagītikāni tya yuktavadanopaśobhitaḥ / syām athāpi bhavadarcanakriyāpreyasīparigatāśayaḥ sadā
verses.devanagari: त्वत्प्रलापमयरक्तगीतिकानि त्य युक्तवदनोपशोभितः / स्याम् अथापि भवदर्चनक्रियाप्रेयसीपरिगताशयः सदा
verses.english: Everybody wants songs and a beautiful girl. Songs and a beautiful girl are liked by everybody. Everybody wants a girl and songs, various songs. I too also want the same thing, but in another way.

verses.iast: īhitaṃ na bata pārameśvaraṃ śakyate gaṇayituṃ tathā ca me / dattam apy amṛtanirbharaṃ vapuḥ svaṃ na pātum anumanyate tathā
verses.devanagari: ईहितं न बत पारमेश्वरं शक्यते गणयितुं तथा च मे / दत्तम् अप्य् अमृतनिर्भरं वपुः स्वं न पातुम् अनुमन्यते तथा
verses.english: [These are] the tricks of Lord Śiva, O people!

verses.iast: tvām agādham avikalpam advayaṃ svaṃ svarūpam akhilārthaghasmaram / āviśann aham umeśa sarvadā pūjayeyam abhisaṃstuvīya ca
verses.devanagari: त्वाम् अगाधम् अविकल्पम् अद्वयं स्वं स्वरूपम् अखिलार्थघस्मरम् / आविशन्न् अहम् उमेश सर्वदा पूजयेयम् अभिसंस्तुवीय च
verses.english: O Lord, leave that [issue of] Your fraudness aside. I don’t say that! I didn’t mean that! It was just because I was perturbed [laughter].

chapters.label: Chapter Fourteen
chapters.title: Singing the Glory of Lord Śiva Jayastotranāma caturdaśaṁ stotram

verses.iast: jayalakṣmīnidhānasya nijasya svāminaḥ puraḥ / jayodghoṣaṇapīyūṣarasam āsvādaye kṣaṇam
verses.devanagari: जयलक्ष्मीनिधानस्य निजस्य स्वामिनः पुरः / जयोद्घोषणपीयूषरसम् आस्वादये क्षणम्
verses.english: My own master is the treasure of all glory. My master is the treasure . . .

verses.iast: jayaikarudraikaśiva mahādeva maheśvara / pārvatīpraṇayiñ śarva sarvagīrvāṇapūrvaja
verses.devanagari: जयैकरुद्रैकशिव महादेव महेश्वर / पार्वतीप्रणयिञ् शर्व सर्वगीर्वाणपूर्वज
verses.english: These are only āmantraṇas (āmantraṇa means calling).

verses.iast: jaya trailokyanāthaikalāñchanālikalocana / jaya pītartalokārtikālakūṭāṅkakandhara
verses.devanagari: जय त्रैलोक्यनाथैकलाञ्छनालिकलोचन / जय पीतर्तलोकार्तिकालकूटाङ्ककन्धर
verses.english: Trailokyanāthaikalāñcchanā alikalocana. You know, O Lord, why You have kept this third eye on Your forehead? This is the indication that You have made, in this respect, that, “I, [Lord Śiva], am the only master of all the three worlds”. This is the indication of being the master of the three worlds. This [third eye] You have kept as a sign of that indication. Glory be to Thee! You just live long, for always!

verses.iast: jaya mūrtatriśaktyātmiśataśūlollasatkara / jayecchāmātrasiddārthapūjārhacaraṇāmbuja
verses.devanagari: जय मूर्तत्रिशक्त्यात्मिशतशूलोल्लसत्कर / जयेच्छामात्रसिद्दार्थपूजार्हचरणाम्बुज
verses.english: [Utpaladeva] reveals His history also in this Jayastotra and, at the same time, glorifies Him with long life and prosperity.

verses.iast: jaya śobhaśatasyandilokottaravapurdhara / jayaikajaṭikākṣīṇagaṅgākṛtyāttabhasmaka
verses.devanagari: जय शोभशतस्यन्दिलोकोत्तरवपुर्धर / जयैकजटिकाक्षीणगङ्गाकृत्यात्तभस्मक
verses.english: All of these are āmantraṇa words. They are all āmantraṇas.

verses.iast: jaya kṣīrodaparyastajyotsnācchāyānulepana / jayeśvarāṅgasaṅgottharatnakāntāhimaṇḍana
verses.devanagari: जय क्षीरोदपर्यस्तज्योत्स्नाच्छायानुलेपन / जयेश्वराङ्गसङ्गोत्थरत्नकान्ताहिमण्डन
